epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤獨的阿振在工作中飽受同事的欺凌。當他選擇與由美一起度過生日時,朋友卻驚覺由美竟是一個充氣娃娃。阿振渴望有人陪伴,於是轉向網路,並找到了理想中的女孩米娜。米娜的出現徹底改變了他的生活,然而,當米娜的吸..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely Ah Zhen is bullied by his coworkers. When he spends his birthday with Yumi, his friends shockingly discover that Yumi is an inflatable doll. Seeking companionship, Ah Zhen turns to the internet and finds his ideal girl Mina. Her arrival transforms his life but a series of unexpected events unfold as her identity as a vampire is revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Olivia是位出色的吸血鬼言情小說作家,一直渴望遇到真正的吸血鬼。當吸血鬼Luke出現在Olivia位於雪地的偏僻小屋向她求助時,她的夢想終於成真。然而,當Luke的吸血鬼同伴在平安夜那天追捕他時,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Olivia, an outstanding vampire romance novelist, longs to encounter a real vampire. Her wish comes true when Luke turns up at her remote snowbound cabin seeking for help. However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Lukes vampire companions track him down...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家決心撰寫一部暢銷小說來挽救自己的事業。他重返童年居所,這裡也是他成功作家父親神秘離世的地方。當他發現父親的最後手稿時,才意識到這部作品遠超出他的能力。因此,他決定抄襲這份作品,卻隨即..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer must write a hit novel to save his career. He retreats to his childhood home where his father, also a successful writer, died mysteriously. Upon discovering his fathers final manuscript, he realizes its far superior to anything he could create. He decides to plagiarize the work, setting off a series of horrifying events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 羅雪與男友吵架後,出走來到深山民宿與伊伊成為合租室友。一晚,羅雪無意中撞破依依及其友人雷松殺死依依的前男友。為免走漏消息,他們囚禁羅雪於閣樓中。羅雪的知己蘇文發現她失蹤後,到處找尋她的下落。最後,羅雪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote BB accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yis ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xues buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次車禍後失憶的王人傑找到夜間警衛的工作。午夜,他準時抵達廢棄的大廈上班,卻發現三隻冤魂如約而至,並揭發了一場復仇計畫。究竟這是命運的安排還是邪靈的詛咒?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horrors haunt each family from within, and nothing is really as it seems.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their fathers death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their fathers death which now threatens them both.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天凌晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jas正與妹妹Laura享受著鄉郊的平靜假期,這份寧靜卻被一群突然出現的流浪漢徹底打破。Laura慘遭殺害後,Jas回到租來的小屋,發現妹妹冰冷的屍體。在悲慟與狂怒之中,她誓言追獵這群兇徒到底,定要其..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jass peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sisters murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their fathers death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their fathers death which now threatens them both.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對青梅竹馬的情侶相隔多年後在神秘的吉祥賭坊相遇,二人決意要一起剷除貪污的將軍、罪犯和勒索者!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical Lucky Casino and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 郭靖與黃蓉將結拜兄弟楊康之子撫養成人,並取名楊過。黃蓉恐其學武後,替父報仇,為免養虎為患,不許楊過習武。負氣出走的楊過偶遇走火入魔的歐陽鋒,獲授蛤蟆功,更無意中獲悉自己的身世……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his father’s death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and enc

epg.programme_title_en: The Blue and the Black Part 2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 劇情承接上集,唐琪結束夜總會歌女生涯,在戰亂中跑遍中國尋找愛人張醒亞,但醒亞卻糾纏於日軍,叛亂分子及將軍的美麗女兒當中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlords beautiful daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張徹導演的武俠鉅作《水滸傳》的延續。七大梁山的英雄義士為保國家,奉命征討宦官專權。展開一場轟轟烈烈之蕩寇大決戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh’s epic “The Water Margin”, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

epg.programme_title_en: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆皇繼續微服南巡,這次得大臣和大學士陪行,他們一行三人來到揚州,期間遇上不少趣事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 此片述說了關於林沖的故事。宋朝禁軍教頭林沖遭受貪官陷害,被放逐滄州,更陷入險境。幸得花和尚相助,林沖成功脫險,更展開復仇大計。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty’s Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沈昌生性沉鬱,與父親缺乏溝通,被人利用,誤入歧途。昌逃不過暴力的魔爪和色情的引誘,竟然出賣父親,讓父親慘死。昌悲悔交加,獨闖飛仔巢,逐一將之擊斃,自已也進入瘋狂狀態。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大俠張七郎退隱江湖多年,他的妻兒及朋友卻被鬼頭黨所殺。悲憤的七郎打算獨力與鬼王決一生死,為他們報仇雪恨!惡名昭彰的鬼頭黨最終會被他打敗嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gang’s leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 劇情講述,知縣之子劉子和,垂涎葛小大之妻小白菜,用迷藥將其姦污。劉子和事後恐東窗事發,用砒霜毒死葛小大。葛死後,鎮內流言四起,知縣為救愛兒,設計嫁禍小白菜婚前戀人楊乃武。乃武被苦打成招,其姊楊淑英不忍見弟含冤而死,到刑部要求翻案……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she’s soon framed for her husband’s murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片改編自著名武俠小說家黃鷹之同名小說。故事講述,丁鵬與蕭立本是同門師兄弟,而丁妻與蕭妻則是兩姊妹。兩家本極為友好,後來丁妻誕下一子,而蕭妻誕下一女,但蕭獨喜子。丁妻為了成全姐夫心願,便來一個男女對換,惟完成此事後便告死去。蕭妻內心有愧,手抱兒子往見丁,不料為蕭暗中看見,頓生綠帽疑雲,狠然佈下瘋子殺
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fiancé. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年廣州西關的陳家大屋,家道中落只剩下陳秀英及其入贅之丈夫楊振宇。秀英多病,而振宇又鬱鬱不得志,故常遭振宇辱打。直至自稱陳家僕人之女梁綺華的出現,聯同秀英反抗,竟錯手將振宇殺死!秀英自始活在驚恐之中,最終被振宇的鬼魂嚇死!原來這只是振宇在與綺華合谋殺害秀英,就在振宇以為可與綺華共築愛巢之際,秀英
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述,惡少洪毛九不時到蘇記飯店滋事搗蛋,蘇老闆欺善怕惡,把滿腔氣憤發洩在夥記阿七身上。後阿七發覺小廚師張彪武功不凡,遂暗中模仿其動作練武;一日洪毛九又來飯店滋擾,阿七施展出所練功夫打得洪毛九狼狽而逃…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For lovers of the Shaws sumptuous production and martial arts expertise, this action adventure in the Jackie Chan style is a special treat. A persecuted waiter turns to a drunken master for help when a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年醫生時振聲在醫院中發現很多奇難雜症,無法以醫學理論解釋,遂請好友齊中平夫婦共同研究。幾經追查,才發現那些病人均是中了降頭。原來施降者是精通邪術,以「愛情降頭」協助富商追求夢中情人,博取巨額報酬。中平不信妖邪之說,其妻子更不惜以身相試,更被施以「死降」,如果無法破解,二十四小時後便會身亡…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing’s wife and casts an evil love spell on

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張生、崔鶯鶯才子佳人相會,俏紅娘從中牽赤繩;西廂夜訪,私定終身;崔老夫人知情大怒,憤而拷紅;紅娘怨夫人不該言而無信,終成就百年姻緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family’s objection, s

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花木蘭因父親年事已高,毅然女扮男裝替父從軍,對戰匈奴。她英勇善戰,屢立奇功,更被擢升為大將軍。木蘭衣錦還鄉,為家族贏得了無上的榮光。元帥欲將女兒許配給她的時候,才得知她是女兒身。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to mar

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花木蘭因父親年事已高,毅然女扮男裝替父從軍,對戰匈奴。她英勇善戰,屢立奇功,更被擢升為大將軍。木蘭衣錦還鄉,為家族贏得了無上的榮光。元帥欲將女兒許配給她的時候,才得知她是女兒身。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to mar

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一班不打不相識之眾,聚集在一起以保護愛國將軍免被加害。他們充當將軍的護送人員,前往危險的遠方英國領事館,途中遭到敵人和日軍的陰險干擾。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the general’s escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanes

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1973年,香港股市暴漲人人熱衷炒賣股票,小市民因急於入住廉租屋而被不法之徒騙取金錢,及教育制度不健全引起民怨等均被改編成電影中的情節。故事諷刺寫實,反映了香港當時的真實面貌!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kongs social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕龍劍飛武功低劣,但在一次偶然的機會下,被火魂邪神古漢魂收為義子,並獲傳授八式如來神掌。龍劍飛從此脫胎換骨,成為武林高手。為報師仇,古漢魂命龍劍飛下山替他找仇人報仇,江湖風暴遂再牽起…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddhas Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祝英台既為女兒身,卻穿男兒裝上學堂,與同窗梁山伯結下生死之愛。山伯得悉真相後,前往祝家求親,豈料英台已被許配他人,二人被迫分開。山伯傷心欲絕,一病不起。英台驚聞噩耗,哭墳跳進墓裡殉情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to go to school and falls hopelessly in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After Shan Bo realizes her true identity, he proposes marriage to Ying Tai. However, they are kept apart as she is engaged to another man. K

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「叉手」為江湖上新崛起之組織,專殺江湖豪俠,彼等行事,均帶面具,故彼等究為何人,無人知曉。「八臂哪吒」齊山雲會同曾軍及梁勇等,赴景陽鎮調查叉手總壇之所在,擬一舉殲滅該組織,為江湖除害。三人在客棧見一沉默寡言之伙頭,態度極為神秘,暗忖此人必也是來偵查「叉手」者...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A mysterious new gang, the Masked Avengers, is slaughtering the martial worlds greatest heroes. To stop them, three fearless fighters must track down the gangs hidden lair in Jingyang Town and put an end to their reign of terror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事共有四個單元,講述濟公四出助人的善行,包括幫助一對母女避過倒塌的石牆,助菜販免受惡霸的滋擾,又為年青人尋回被盜的金錢,更以巧計教訓胡作非爲的相爺父子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his so

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 余乾文與同門師弟鄭坤元奉師父之命下山尋訪「天地劍」,以免它落入壞人手中造成武林浩劫。余乾文途中巧遇五毒教教主之女蘇皎皎,兩人情投意合。可惜,當蘇皎皎意外地弄傷鄭坤元後,事情也開始變得越來越複雜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two disciples, Yu and Zheng, are sent by their master to track down the invincible weapon “Thundering Sword” to prevent villains from getting it. Yu encounters the daughter of a ruthless clan, Chiao, who is on her way to seek for the sword. They quic

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述,青年漁夫魯金虎與漁女小玉自幼相好;土豪獨子耀祖,垂涎小玉美色,時藉故親近;一天耀祖欺負寡婦五嫂,金虎抱不平,幾動武,惹小玉誤會金虎與五嫂有不尋常關係…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu’s beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu  protects another woman from the bully one day, leading

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1933年,日軍出動兵團兩萬,戰車五十餘輛,進攻「八道樓子」的據點。我軍以寡敵眾,死守「八道樓子」抵禦日軍進攻,血戰五日五夜,終於失守。日軍發現樓內,只有七具血肉模糊的屍體,為之肅然起敬,立碑「支那七勇士」之墓。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This iconoclastic film retells the legend of seven Chinese patriots, who sacrificed their lives to defend against 20,000 Japanese soldiers and 50 tanks for 5 days, at a strategic key point of the Great Wall known as Pa Tou Lou Tzu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 淩波的丈夫高遠及其友王俠,均與肚皮舞女郎孟莉有染,孟藉此勒索二人;後孟被殺,高成嫌疑犯,另孟之兄翟諾,亦向高勒索;而淩在家,也接見了穀峰,他聲言有為高洗罪的證據,但要索錢;王妻李香君借貸給淩... 究竟誰是殺孟真凶?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mrs Lins husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin’s

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牧羊女古秀秀喜唱山歌,父親嗜賭如命;青年劉大龍與秀對唱山歌,情愫互生。曾老虎以追債要脅古老頭許婚;劉欲酬錢替秀父還債。怎知帆船歸來而劉卻失蹤!秀無奈答允出嫁...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father’s towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丁安安與雍晴兩個表姐妹自小就讀於同一所女校,因二人的母親一向口和心不和,從小就向自己女兒灌輸好勝思想,因此形成安安與晴從小鬥到大,三日一小吵,五日一大鬥。她們在校中認識了男同學米高及保羅,很快成為情侶,兩對小冤家後來因鬥氣竟然互調了男朋友…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness  innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocenc

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在河北省某貪汙成風的小縣內,流浪漢甄明與賈亮因掌握一眾縣官的貪汙和醜聞證據,得以順水推舟假扮縣長,把各官員玩弄於股掌之中,峰迴路轉,結局卻出人意表。全片除帶出人生如戲的黑色幽默,也狠狠地鞭撻為官者殘民以自肥的無恥行為。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奸相秦權病重,危在旦夕,派手下爭奪長生籐。護衛司馬駿與「九指魔女」沙沙向藥師處取藥被拒,便殺死了藥師。師弟鐵二郎盜走了長生籐,司馬駿追殺鐵二郎,兩人展開了生死決鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who wa

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 酷愛音樂的留學生李英偉臨危受命替老父接管公司,其嬉皮士形像為祖母不屑。李的公司職員林仲鵬乘機製造事端,圖謀奪取其總經理之職位。李之青梅竹馬朋友王鳳不忍見李受屈,化身金髮美人巧施妙計助他解困,自此李對此神秘女郎一見鍾情 。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 高堅是武林大豪石正仲門下小弟子,但因石正仲性格偏執,常不問是非情由就對高堅施以懲罰。一次,高救了師父的仇人金天運,金為報恩將武功授給高,高卻被判「背叛師門」之罪...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master’s rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片講述唐僧、孫悟空、豬八戒及沙和尚一行四人往西天取經,行至西梁女兒國,國內全是女人,而傳宗接代生兒育女全靠「招胎泉」,飲過這泉水便可成孕,但也只能生女。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漢高祖死後,呂后專權,密詔太尉設法殺死代王劉恆。幪面大俠發現其詭計後,馬上告知劉恆。劉於是急遣護衛保護公主往長安求援。太尉率大隊軍馬沿途追殺公主,幸得幪面大俠保護,處處化險為夷。最後,幪面大俠更助劉恆成功繼承漢室大統。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior pr

epg.programme_title_en: The Dream of the Red Chamber
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部電影改編自中國史上最廣受歡迎的文學作品《紅樓夢》,被譽為同名電影中最成功的作品。樂蒂生動地詮釋了美麗卻帶有一絲哀愁的林黛玉角色,也因此贏得了「古典美人」的美譽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh’s looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet Classic Beauty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強宜本是夜總會歌星,後來為尋初戀女友水仙的下落,被人帶到匪幫的木屋。原來,強宜少年時誤入歧途,有打劫殺人的犯罪紀錄,綽號「小煞星」。一哥要脅他共同打劫珠寶行,否則公開他的秘密。強宜假意應承,從長計議。想不到當日行動踏入珠寶行,發現售貨員竟然是初戀女友水仙!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一次醉酒後,武松赤手空拳打死一隻猛虎,因此被任命為都頭。武松兄長武大郎的妻子潘金蓮色誘武松,但遭他拒絕。後來,潘金蓮和富戶西門慶有染,及後姦情敗露,兩人繼而毒死了武大郎。武松知悉後,先殺潘金蓮再殺西門慶,為兄長報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝光緒年間,守衛森嚴的大內金庫,竟遭悍匪劫去黃金二萬兩,慈禧太后大為震怒。外號「萬人斬」的京都捕房總捕頭冷天鷹受命於三個月內,緝捕匪首方逢甲歸案。方逢甲佈署大批匪徒喬裝村民,向冷天鷹施以突擊,冷在猝不及防下終告受傷。失明少女方蘭姑讓冷在屋內養傷,未幾,方逢甲突然出現,原來蘭姑乃其獨女...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kuei Chih-hung was famous for his modern day crime thrillers, his horror flicks, and even his comedies. But if the only kung-fu film he ever made was this one, he’d still be spoken of with respect by even the most ardent martial arts movie fan. Many

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 男孩小吉的父母離異後,希望尋找快樂的人生。一天,小吉喜遇好心鬼簡人,並結成好友。好心鬼決定要幫助小吉的父母復合,令小吉得到真正的快樂。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠沈浪與六大門派高手商討對付奸梟歡喜王,正值莊內嚴肅之際,其未婚妻竟無理取鬧,沈只好帶其未婚妻離開。其後,二人繼續追捕歡喜王,但卻意外墮入歡喜王的圈套。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial artist Shen Lang is in discussions with kung fu experts from the other six sects to plot the downfall of the traitorous Happy King when his fiancée suddenly disrupts them and Shen has to quickly bring her away. As they continue to pursue the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三個香港美少女何莉莉、陳依齡及淩雲,帶著愛情夢遠赴日本大阪,一心指望釣得如意郎君。豈料三人被誤會是富家千金,結果惹出趣事連篇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由七位壇主控制的「七煞會」,在江湖上掀起腥風血雨, 人人聞風喪膽。朝廷特派刑部尚書楊宇統籌剿滅,並派臥底從內瓦解組織,隨著「七煞會」內衝突不斷升溫,幕後壇主可會找出臥底?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji; and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a n

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編。故事講述唐僧赴西天取經,中途在五指山收服馬騮精;在高家莊收服豬八戒;在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節。。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang’s journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年俠士辛酸得悉王爺擬委託四大殺手押送神秘箱子往西安,且將付出十萬兩銀子作酬金,辛遂殺四人及持其頭顱往見王爺,求接辦保鏢事,蓋辛欲得該筆巨額酬金作賑災之用,王爺允之。辛途遇妙手怪丐楊風、無形劍客古非天及美豔女俠水仙花等高手截劫。原來當中牽涉通敵叛國的陰謀...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword an

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三個歌舞女郎張萍、葉鳳、林芝蘭,隨歌舞團去台北表演,歌舞團經紀陳彼德原與葉拍拖,但陳移情於胡聞鶯。張萍出發前被男友拋棄,葉鳳要從鶯手上追回陳彼德的愛,林芝蘭為卻一心不嫁富豪誓不回。引出烏龍百出的愛情喜劇……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九姑娘之兄巴傑勾結惡虎村惡霸胡蛟,圖劫鏢銀,被「鐵沙掌」駱宏勛打傷。胡蛟恐事發後被巴家追究,下毒將巴傑毒斃,嫁禍駱宏勛,巴家上下誓欲殺死駱報仇……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo b

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漢朝末年太師董卓霸道專橫,弄權禍國,忠臣王允誓要利用貂蟬的美色設計除掉董卓。王允得知董卓的義子呂布見貂蟬貌若天仙一見鍾情,於是將計就計把貂蟬獻給董卓為妾,終使父子反目。呂布最後殺了父親董卓,自此與貂蟬成為眷屬。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn’s beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong’s concubine as he knows Dong’s adopted son Lu Bu is in love w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名珠寶神偷棄邪歸正,搖身一變成為夜總會歌手。發生連串搶劫案後,他馬上又成為嫌疑犯。於是,神偷設計捉拿冒認者,最終會否連累自己?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 續集中阿牛不幸的遭遇更令人心痛,當中不少更是笑中有淚的經歷。阿牛出獄後,再遇愛人阿花,可惜她已嫁為人妻;另一方面,戇直的阿牛仍不斷被狡猾的周大叔欺騙...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 得知弟弟殺死黑社會頭目後,唐人杰毅然承擔罪責,成為殺手追殺的目標。在江南浪子的協助下,他終於成功復仇,卻驚覺江南浪子正是殺害父親的真兇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一部經典戰爭鉅片,描述抗日戰爭時人民的生活狀況。畫家俞瑞意外救了由鄉下被拐賣來的女子荷花。兩人互生情愫,不久更結為夫妻過著幸福的日子。無奈好景不常,不久日軍全面侵入中國,亦正式展開殘酷的統治…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 流浪漢馮大剛被誤指為劫匪,遭逮捕後關押於死囚牢。真正的劫匪為了滅口,賄賂獄中扒手楊靈對馮大剛下毒手。楊靈明白馮大剛是冤枉的,於是暗中設法幫助他逃獄。誰料逃獄計劃意外失敗,最終兩人反而成為真正的死囚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Fengs innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, t

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鋼琴師李燕南與樂隊指揮女兒陳小芸相愛,常指點她歌唱技巧。小芸在一次代替演出中一鳴驚人,得團主及花花公子杜邦傑力捧。小芸赴星馬演出,心卻惦念燕南,一夜與杜邦傑于車內發生爭執,怎料汽車失事...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unw

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 職業殺手雷振華在尖東某夜總會成功殺死黑道名流四哥等人後,悄然來到馬來西亞並住進唐人街對面一舊式旅館。唐人街的豪華酒店裡正舉行一個盛大婚禮,新郎石先生正是雷計畫用三分半鐘解決的目標,不料,未等雷下手,另一殺手已捷足先登,倒在地上卻是另一要人,雷頓時成了替罪羊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金小芳是一位活潑且無畏的鄉村少女,面對惡霸從不退縮,總是勇敢反抗。當她揭露了唐家大少爺的陰謀後,立刻引來他的狠毒報復。幸好,她心儀的男子大海及時挺身而出相救。兩人能否攜手對抗險惡命運,改寫結局?

epg.programme_title_tc: 反恐特戰隊之刺殺危機
epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
我方情報部門截獲情報,H國恐怖勢力黑日組織一號頭目山貓將要入境。武警反恐前敵指揮部指揮長少將常建安迅速集結武警神鷹和雪狼反恐特戰隊部署實施“剿貓行動。
老奸巨猾的山貓在即將進入中國國境之時,臨時改變路線,我方潛伏在恐怖組織內部的特勤人員颶..
該片以1940年初侵華日軍重兵偷襲八路軍前線總指揮部的危急時刻,時任八路軍三八六旅參謀長周希漢抗命救駕的史實及一段情緣為依據,真誠的展現了大智大勇、敢作敢為、鐵骨柔腸的一代戰將周希漢——中國的巴頓。

epg.programme_title_en: The Gunshots of The Secret Service
epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
通過上海解放前夕黨的地下工作者在敵人內部所進行的尖銳、複雜、激烈的鬥爭,表現了這一戰線上英雄人物的堅貞不渝、機智勇敢,對黨、對人民的無限忠誠的思想。

    第三次國內革命戰爭時期,在國民黨白色恐怖下的上海,由於叛徒的出賣,我打入敵軍..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a well-known movie with great success of box-office in the early 1980s. Planted in the middle of Kuomintang, the communist party members engage with their rivals in Shanghai during the third domestic revolutionary war.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在1948年冬天上海的一棟弄堂房子裡。小官僚侯義伯非法霸佔了這所房子,把原房主孔有文趕到小耳房裡,他自己和姘婦餘小瑛住在二樓。政府搖搖欲墜,侯義伯急於把房子出售撈幾個錢逃命。這件事引起房客們的恐慌,大家忙想辦法對付。但與世無爭的孔有文不敢挺..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story took place in a house that located in Shanghai in the year of 1948. Hou Yibo took the house illegally, and then he drove the original house-owner Kong Youwen away.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
海歸青年周宇飛帶著在國外意外懷孕的妻子姚倩倩一起返回北京家中,費盡心計,終於使父親、岳母和妻子答應了他留下孩子的請求,並承諾孩子出生後,由其照顧,讓姚倩倩安心複習功課,回國外複讀。
這件事剛剛平息,周宇飛陷入了新的夾板氣:父親是老腦筋,認為..
元朝末年,各地義軍並起,形成割據之局,為鎮壓起義軍,河南王擴闊帖木兒奉命尋找南宋留下的一處龍脈,在尋寶途中與龍門派丘處機、少年時期的張三豐展開的一場驚心動魄的末世英雄傳。
白石村能人張大河為賺大錢,決定將“夕陽紅養老院轉為農家樂,這讓已適應養老院生活的老人們措手不及。老人們各尋養老之處,最後只剩下綽號“樹爺的老人陳青松。樹爺無兒無女,房子拆遷,無處可去,他拒絕賠償,耗在養老院就是不搬。為逼走樹爺,張大河使..

epg.programme_title_tc: 九紋龍史進之除惡史家村
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史家莊少莊主史進年輕氣盛,俠肝義膽。年輕時拜師七人,每拜一師便在身上紋一條青龍。不料第八位師父陰狠險惡,險些釀的他家破人亡。幸虧得到恩師王進得救,手刃了仇人,史進紋得第九條青龍。
該片講述了護國密探羅冰截獲了反臣慶王爺的造反篡位的信件,冒死送往京城救駕、護駕,最後揭穿了慶王爺的陰謀,掃除了叛臣逆黨,穩定了社稷。

epg.programme_title_tc: 毛驢縣令之棒子老虎雞
epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
清朝皇帝微服出巡途遇土匪劫財,女俠一枝花拔刀相助,伍四六救駕來遲,為了將功補過,皇上命他暗查侯王爺。
侯王爺派殺手毀滅證據除掉一枝花,伍四六挺身而出,與侯王爺鬥智鬥勇,最終為一枝花洗脫冤情。

影片講述了抗擊英國向中國傾銷鴉片的故事.
 道光年間,由於英商向中國輸入鴉片,中國白銀大量外流。湖廣總督林則徐從民族大局考慮,上書道光皇帝,請求查禁鴉片。道光皇帝堅定禁煙決心,並命林則徐為欽差大臣,前往廣東。林則徐人還未到,便傳令兩廣總督鄧..
草根縣令伍四六奉命到遼東清河赴任,趕上特大荒旱,他在千方百計解救災民的同時與貪官污吏展開鬥爭,為了揭露金知府夥同廉親王侵吞朝廷救災銀兩之惡行,伍知縣冒死給皇上送去了“請罪奏摺,在夫人麻翠姑的幫助下,出生入死終於見到了皇上,懲治了貪官。

epg.programme_title_en: CHINESE WRESTLING LEGEND OF THE HUNDRED FIST
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佟忠義回到滄州後,被選為鏢會的會長,一時間成為整個滄州的精神領袖。直到劉天霸忽然擺擂臺,徹底打破了這一切,卻促使佟忠義成為了一代“跤王。
六騎司前首領延東的墓被盜,鎮壓妖王的玄牝珠遺失,長安城妖孽四起。魚公公命六騎司鎮壓群妖和追尋玄牝珠,並策劃一場驚天陰謀。結果玄牝珠被廚師李長安誤食,他置之死地而後生,發動玄牝珠的神奇力量伏妖除魔。

文化宮內,棋盤上,古代戰爭場面瞬間變成一盤象棋殘局,象棋大師陳文山無奈之下棄..

電視臺節目主持人孟怡與被辭退的照明工趙明亮偶然相遇、相識。在電視臺舉辦的寶貝猜猜看節目中,趙明亮被人利用至使演播現場突然斷電,價值百萬的古瓶摔個粉碎。孟怡被解除聘用合同。由於此事發生在文物局準備回購文物的前夕,引起公安部門的高度重視,他們派..

紮拉和桑吉卓瑪是青藏高原上的兩個藏族孩子。
一次偶然的機遇,小卓瑪的父親奪得了賽馬會上的冠軍,小卓瑪請小紮拉到自己的家裡參加篝火慶祝晚會。晚會上可愛的小卓瑪盡顯驕人的本領和才藝,並教會了小紮拉跳舞,倆人在燦爛的星空下,發下了屬於孩子的“誓言..
暖男林大健和高富帥在真人秀上為爭奪女神芳心無所不用其極,鬧出了一系列爆笑的追愛烏的故事。
洋行老闆Peter朱買下一份巨額保險後撞車,劉志遠帶領趙奎勇、王胖子和小麻杆接到任務破案,揭開了重重迷霧
警校剛畢業的雷霄被綏河市刑警隊隊長聶國斌選中潛入以鐘鼎為首的假鈔集團臥底。雷霄冒著生命危險,與犯罪分子機智周旋。鐘鼎逃亡到俄羅斯後,雷霄在俄方員警娜塔莎、斯塔斯巧妙配合下,終於將鐘鼎等人繩之以法。

在解放前的舊上海,三毛是舊社會的一個失去了父母的流浪兒,在飄著雪花的冬季,他瑟縮著在牆角發抖,吃的是殘菜剩羹,住的是垃圾推和小狗窩,天冷了把麻袋披在身上擋寒。

該片以1940年初侵華日軍重兵偷襲八路軍前線總指揮部的危急時刻,時任八路軍三八六旅參謀長周希漢抗命救駕的史實及一段情緣為依據,真誠的展現了大智大勇、敢作敢為、鐵骨柔腸的一代戰將周希漢——中國的巴頓。
該片講述了李玄立志煉丹,想救百姓病苦的青年,因為陰錯陽差,失去自己原有身體,而得到叫化子的殘軀,在太上老君點撥下,他結合這一副殘軀,繼續行醫救人,最後名列仙班,成為八仙中的鐵拐李。.
1943年7月,延安邊區政府紀念中國共產黨成立二十二周年歌詠大會上,剛剛在整編中調到警衛團的張思德,因為在合唱中的表現,被毛主席所認識。在1933年一起進入隊伍的四川儀隴老鄉中,張思德和眾多已經當上團長、旅長的老鄉比起來,還只是一個普通的戰..

epg.programme_title_tc: 九紋龍史進之血戰東平
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 講述了那家威飾演的東平府兵馬都督董平在九紋龍史進和時遷的數次勸說下歸順梁山,最終協助史進拿下東平故事。
講述了明朝末年,錦衣衛搶奪少林信物木棉袈裟、掌管少林的狂妄企圖,被少林武當聯手回擊,合力剷除的故事。
本片通過對人物角色的深度挖掘和內心刻畫,淋漓盡致地展示了一群戰爭背景下的中國軍人的真實內心世界。在鐵血男兒中有為了填飽肚子、混口飯吃而參軍的“小饅頭,也有貪圖仕途而加入的“軍需官,但在生死攸關面前,他們無一例外、義無反顧的投入到了這場生..
清朝末年,江南一帶乾旱成災,一時間餓殍遍野,百姓民不聊生。此時,曹化之貪污“兩河工程款一案,在京城和坊間引起巨大反響,百姓痛恨,皇宮震驚。皇上傳出諭旨,責令京城都察院限期破案。皇宮裡九侯爺暗中散佈消息,說曹化之越獄逃跑。女捕快鐵飛花立下軍..

馬文卿留書出走，卿母大為緊張，要丈夫馬醫師尋回愛女。馬隨便找來報販肥佬、瘦佬代為尋女，兩人發現卿已尋回生父馮翁，並已成了千金小姐。後來馮翁遭匪徒捉走，瘦佬施計通知卿及其男友羅青等人，青率眾終成功救人。

牛魔王與鐵扇公主之子紅孩兒捉了唐僧，孫悟空找來觀音相助，觀音收服紅並收其為徒。唐僧等路經火燄山，需向鐵借扇以撲滅火焰，鐵不肯，雙方起衝突，牛被捉困天門。鐵為救夫火燒天門，時觀音來調停，悟空終成功借扇。
畫家畢加繩生活潦倒。一日，繩偶遇謝美珍，對她魂牽夢縈，並得好友助他約會。繩的畫無人問津，好友著他假死以令其畫作升值，果然買家爭相訂購。珍被逼與富家子來往，繩得知後，決定放棄財富公開真相，終與珍成眷屬。

epg.programme_title_en: Red Child Saves His Mother, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牛魔王、鐵扇公主因犯天條而被貶下凡間。多年後火燄山爆發，龍王取得舍利子後，再施美人計騙取芭蕉扇以抗熱，牛受誘中計。鐵往龍宮尋夫慘遭囚禁，幸獲紅孩兒所救。時孫悟空為尋舍利子而至，龍王終歸還寶物平息風波。
李大偉與羅翠玲將新屋的一個房間租予楊志華。一次，玲代華修補褲子，偉看見感不悅。其後偉更誤會兩人有姦情，決意離婚，成全二人。當偉得知真相，欲阻止玲與華成婚，於結婚當日，偉發現新娘是華的女友，才知被戲弄。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牛魔王、鐵扇公主因犯天條而被貶下凡間。多年後火燄山爆發，龍王取得舍利子後，再施美人計騙取芭蕉扇以抗熱，牛受誘中計。鐵往龍宮尋夫慘遭囚禁，幸獲紅孩兒所救。時孫悟空為尋舍利子而至，龍王終歸還寶物平息風波。

富家小姐方翠瑩與陸又民邂逅，因民不喜結交富有人家，故瑩隱瞞身分與民交往，後二人更成眷屬。婚後，民得知瑩的身分，無奈接受。民偶遇舊女友盧麗蓮，讓瑩誤會，幸得蓮解釋，瑩與民終明白夫婦應坦誠相對，二人和好。
牛魔王與鐵扇公主之子紅孩兒捉了唐僧，孫悟空找來觀音相助，觀音收服紅並收其為徒。唐僧等路經火燄山，需向鐵借扇以撲滅火焰，鐵不肯，雙方起衝突，牛被捉困天門。鐵為救夫火燒天門，時觀音來調停，悟空終成功借扇。
日軍襲港，韓雪花與曾文健帶家人逃命。花到茶樓唱歌維生，卻讓健誤會，幸被母親罵醒，健決參軍。花誕下兒子，卻傳來健身亡消息，花的舊友金老七遂負起照顧花一家的責任。多年後，健與家人重逢，病重的七亦無憾而終。

epg.programme_title_en: Save the Mother from Huang Shing
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魯國王子臨終前託司馬英將國書代為傳送。英冒認魯國王子打敗凌霄將軍迎娶晉國玉霞公主，惜其後被揭發遭放逐。霄與晉妃奪位，幸霞與兒子小龍脫險。龍長大後與英重聚，霞卻被擄走，英與龍去魯國求援，晉室正統終光復。
唐三藏往天竺取西經，先後收孫悟空、沙悟淨、豬八戒為徒。四人路上遇到不少妖怪，悟空多番開殺戒，被三藏趕走。牛魔王擄走三藏，八戒和悟淨向悟空求助，悟空把三藏救出，還騙得芭蕉扇弄熄火焰山的火，四人繼續上路。

epg.programme_title_en: Rich Gentleman and the Fierce, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孔文禮邂逅周玉萍，兩人迅速發展起來。孔、周兩家為婚事起風波，幸得禮好友高廣良獻計，禮、萍才順利完婚。婚後，孔家以為禮夫綱大振，周家則以為萍御夫有道，豈料一次意外，二人把戲被識破，兩家人鬧得不可開交……
李國英遇梁玉梅被張彪欺凌，奮勇相救，兩人情愫互生。英與梅成婚，彪從中挑撥，令李母對梅不滿將她趕走。英患重病，梅賣唱賺錢，英卻誤會梅貪圖富貴，傷心回家。英的舅父揭穿彪的詭計，英知錯怪梅，李母亦與梅冰釋。
黑璇風行俠仗義救人，巧遇打抱不平的一丈紅父女，三人合力救出民女。紅父女賣藝，藍九少看上紅，挾持其父逼她下嫁，紅施計拖延。九少強搶金玉蘭，紅暗中助黑璇風救出蘭，九少追至，紅報官讓九少伏法，成功救出父親。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2084, construction worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall for a virtual Mars vacation—but the procedure unlocks hidden memories, thrusting him into a deadly rebellion and a secret-agent past.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: With the nation of Panem in a full scale war, Katniss confronts President Snow in the final showdown.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,日本特務吉岡意圖找到龍棺裡的徐福寶藏,便命人僱傭探險家陳啟龍尋找一本神秘的竹簡。陳在一座古墓中找到竹簡,及後得知是交給日本人,便搶回竹簡和傭金。根據竹簡上的指引,陳與夥伴們踏上蓬萊仙島尋找寶..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Japanese agent commissions Chinese explorer Chen to locate a bamboo note leading to Xu Fu’s treasure. Chen finds the note but refuses to give it to the Japanese, keeping both the note and his pay. As Chen and his friends follow the instructions to an island where the treasure is concealed, they are unaware that a mysterious pursuit is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 首屈一指的馴鳥師茅山豪,在鳳凰島遭遇變異物種襲擊,並不斷有人離奇失蹤,人心惶惶。為了探尋真相,豪與治安隊隊長孟前冰釋前嫌,並通力合作調查此失蹤案。可怕的是,線索竟指向與僵屍有關!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Phoenix Island is attacked by a mutated object, causing people to mysteriously disappear and inducing panic. Top bird trainer Mao Shan Hao teams up with a  security team leader to investigate the case. The search intensifies as they uncover clues linking the missing victims to zombies, adding a thrilling twist to the case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀七十年代,香港在英國殖民統治下貪腐嚴重,黑惡勢力橫行,毒梟坤哥及豪哥大賺不義之財。廉政公署人員白玫瑰奉命潛伏到黑幫大佬豪哥身邊收集罪證。玫瑰與豪哥日漸熟識,兩人互生情愫。面對一面是將毒梟繩之以法..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Drug lords Kun and Hao prosper amidst a corrupt landscape in the 1970s Hong Kong. ICAC officer Rose embarks on a mission to infiltrate Haos gang to gather evidence. However, as Rose and Hao fall in love, she faces a heart-wrenching dilemma — choosing between her duty to bring him down and the irresistible pull of their intensifying romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天意是天界出名的留級生,因前世孽緣未了無法成仙,後來一次意外他無意釋放了雪女令她越獄下凡,在捉拿雪女過程中,天意發現自己竟是害她淪為雪妖的人。為了彌補過錯,天意自願在陰間路上漂泊千年,一番磨難後,二人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tian Yi is destined to fail as an immortal in heaven. When he accidentally frees Snowy and makes her a demon, he wanders in hell for thousand years to right his wrong. After a series of hardships, Snowy and Tian Yi manages to get married, but the heavenly warriors attempt to arrest Snowy. Can the couple live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多年前九龍黑幫頭目章山河因與人火拼而入獄,此時妻子亦因難產而亡,留下女兒。章出獄後,決定放棄黑幫舊業,獨自撫養女兒。然而章為救昔日兄弟,卻導致黑幫老大塔里意外身亡,因此引來塔的弟弟查儂報復,殺死了他的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Triad boss Zhang was jailed when his wife died after giving birth to their daughter. When Zhang is released, he decides to quit the triad and take care of his daughter but accidentally kills the triad boss. Ta Lis brother, Cha, takes revenge by kidnapping Zhangs daughter, resulting in a deadly battle between the two men.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來的地球資源匱乏,各國頂尖科學家將數種動植物的物種送往火星培養,希望改善火星的環境能夠適合人類居住。然而生物在實驗中開始發生變異攻擊人類,身在火星的專家們情況十分危險。中國派出太空人進行救援,他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 率領神魔眾生征戰天道的上古戰神辰南,經歷沈睡萬年後從雪山之巔的墓群中蘇醒過來,但神力和記憶都被封閉。其後他在與守墓人的激鬥跌入斷崖後,無意間誤入楚國地界。最終辰南在解封自身神力及找回記憶的過程中,更一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ancient God of War Chen Nan, awakens after sleeping in the Snow Mountain for ten thousand years but has lost all his super power and memory. He falls from a cliff in a fight and accidentally enters the Chu State. As Chen Nan gradually restores his strength and memory,  he embarks on a journey to protect the world against evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球太空基地捕捉到一組來自外太空的神秘訊號,為探尋外星文明,艦長“原帶領船員駕駛著星際探索飛船“深空號駛向宇宙,但不久飛船卻神秘失蹤。150年後,深空號突然出現,船上只剩下一名女科學家“尹。在她..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Yuan and his crew explore the mysteries of outer space after the Space Centre detects extraterrestrial signals. However, the spacecraft vanishes after lift-off. 150 years later, the spacecraft reappears, harbouring a female scientist. The secret of outer space is unveiled through her recollection of the crew’s peculiar experience.

epg.programme_title_en: Seventeen and a Half Years Old
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張君佳是一名高中學生,為了接近校花黃巧姍,他想拍一部微電影,讓黃巧姍主演。藝術節快要到來,他決定組織同學們拍一部校園喪屍片,拍攝期間,眾人幾經波折,劇組更瀕臨於崩潰邊沿。然而友情、親情和愛情交織成的共..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Jun Jia directs a micro movie starring the school girl he likes. As Arts festival approaches, Zhang and his classmates decide to make a college zombie movie. They encounter many difficulties in the process and despite the production team falling into pieces, they manage to overcome the challenges with love amongst friends, family and lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 元朝末年,一個名為修羅幕主的神秘組織聲稱擁有武林至寶八極玄盒。他們邀請了頂尖的武林高手參加武林大會,事實上想用秘製毒藥控制他們為組織效力。太極宗師張三豐為要揭露組織的陰謀參加了武林大會,最終解開了八極..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Yuan dynasty, a secret gang invites top martial arts masters to an event to showcase a martial arts treasure, with an intention to drug the masters so that they fall under their control and can serve the gang. Tai Chi master Zhang San Feng attends the event to uncover their plot and successfully destroys the evil gang in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次打擊邊境犯罪的行動中,特種兵王周揚、肖克二人參與了邊境黑勢力清剿活動,卻遭遇戰友慘死,此後兩人陷入深深的不安和自責中。及後在一次面對黑勢力的逆襲時,兩人決定再度聯手,共同對抗敵人。一場正義與邪惡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a mission to extinguish the cross border gangs, Zhou Yang and Xiao Ke of the special task force witness the tragic death of their comrades and feel greatly disturbed and guilty. However, in a counterattack by the gangs, Zhou and Xiao team up again to fight against the gangs.  A final battle between the good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少林習武歸來的方世玉,本打算過平常人的生活,但剛回到家鄉肇慶便牽扯到一樁貪腐案中。朝廷貪官的爪牙鄂爾多帶隊殺人滅口並企圖銷毀證據,方世玉雖面對好友周蓉的慘死,母親被擒為人質,但卻面無懼色,決意反抗到底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Having mastered the Shaolin martial arts, Fang Shi Yu yearns for a tranquil existence back home but becomes entangled in a corruption scandal. The governors henchman assigns a squad to eliminate witnesses and erase all evidence. Despite facing his best friends death and his mothers captivity, Fang vows to fight against the forces of evil.

epg.programme_title_en: The Thousand Faces of Fei Jia
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王小俠本是一個胸無大志,在市井街頭討生活的小鎮青年,與父親老瞎子生活在十隱鎮,唯一的願望就是能治好父親的眼疾。一次偶然令王小俠邂逅了沈藍兒,並意外地捲入了一場陰謀之中。而王小俠為了找能治好父親的眼疾方..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young man Wang Xiao Xia resides in a small town with his blind father. His only desire is to cure his fathers eye disease. One day, he encounters Shen Nan Er by chance and gets embroiled in a conspiracy. In his quest to heal his fathers eyes, he goes to the Qi Yin Sect and finally unveils his hidden identity, which was concealed by his father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濱海市城北某倉庫發生爆炸,排爆組長徐忠民發現與八年前的六一一案件極為相似。那次徐拆彈導致一嫌疑犯死亡,而同黨其中包括阿鬼和刁叔。濱海市倉庫爆炸案的同一天,阿鬼從監獄出來,找刁叔要拿回八年前搶劫案的贓款..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bomb squad leader Xu discovers a warehouse explosion in Binhai City resembling the “June 11” case six years ago, in which one suspect died and another accomplice, Gui, was jailed. On the day the warehouse explodes, Gui is released from prison and goes to claim the robbery booty from Diao. Who is the mastermind behind the bombing?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凡人鐵堅身為孤兒,天生體內沒有劍魂,自幼被煉劍師陳光收養長大、相依為命。鐵因緣際會獲得千年劍聖的異火神力,然而神力在他身上卻遭來橫禍。在燕家掌門燕紫的幫助下,鐵一步步煉化身上的劍聖異火,修成七級劍魂,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A sword smith adopts the orphan Tie Jian, who possesses no talent in mastering the sword. Tie accidentally gained mystic power from the Sword Spirit, but this power brings him misfortunes at the same time. Master Yan Zi helps Tei to train and become a formidable swordsman, shattering a sinister conspiracy by the imperial advisor and the spirits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凡人鐵堅身為孤兒,天生體內沒有劍魂,自幼被煉劍師陳光收養長大、相依為命。鐵因緣際會獲得千年劍聖的異火神力,然而神力在他身上卻遭來橫禍。在燕家掌門燕紫的幫助下,鐵一步步煉化身上的劍聖異火,修成七級劍魂,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A sword smith adopts the orphan Tie Jian, who possesses no talent in mastering the sword. Tie accidentally gained mystic power from the Sword Spirit, but this power brings him misfortunes at the same time. Master Yan Zi helps Tei to train and become a formidable swordsman, shattering a sinister conspiracy by the imperial advisor and the spirits.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1925, the peaceful Bei Hai City is terrorized by a giant crocodile that devours and kills villagers. A police inspector assigns Hunter Lin Qi and his disciples to catch the crocodile, but they soon discover that there are more than one. Fighting with the crocodiles becomes a test of physical strength, and the good and evil of human nature.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在東北下鄉的知識青年胡八一等人為了救助患病的村民畫眉,聯合獵人趙叔前去森林雪人熊洞採集解藥。然而,一夥人突然遭到熊的攻擊,只好逃入黃鼠狼地下洞穴。他們目睹了那裡發生的奇怪事情和出現幻覺。胡等人破除迷信..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Hu Ba and hunter Zhao venture to a bear-guarded cave to find an antidote to cure a sick villager. Attacked by the bear, they take refuge in a weasels cave where they encounter bizarre incidents and illusions. After Hu and Zhao dispelled the superstition trap and uncovered the true culprit, they successfully escape and rescue the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大清年間,偏遠的臨江縣有兩名縣令接連被大蟒蛇咬死,百姓人心惶惶。侍衛蘇乞兒和鐵橋三奉命前往臨江縣調查此案。兩人發現當地毒品極樂丸極為盛行,而在調查當中鐵橋三與蘇乞兒也因極樂丸陷入困境。在逆境面前他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

They journey to Yu Zhan Cave to kill the Pig Demon with other hunters. In the end, Ah Shi sacrifices himself to let the hunters fight their way out, but the result is unexpected...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葛振為了拯救車遲國,加入了殺手組織都司府,成為十二暗軍的預備役,專門執行朝廷的秘密任務。葛振在師傅那裡學到白門五甲絕技,在查案時邂逅秋葵,兩人互生情愫。與此同時十二暗軍中最強的午馬被神秘人殺死,最終葛..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his country, Ge Zhen joins a killer squad assigned for secret government missions. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在地球未來,人類大量排放廢氣製造垃圾,使到地球迎來沙化期。動植物變異產生地球新主人“沙蟲,而它們將人類逼到滅絕邊緣,倖存者只能尋找僅存的避難所“綠洲。一支由富商、科學家、保安隊長、機械師以及混混組..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In future earth, humans emit exhaust gas to produce waste, leading to earths desertification. Desert Bugs are mutated to cause human extinction and the last hope of the survivors is to find the oasis. A team made up of tycoons, scientists, security chiefs, engineers and gangsters embarks on a perilous journey in an armoured tank to find the oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十年前,身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假,不料突發遇到颱風,張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質,妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭,不料又一場颱風來襲,妻子被颱風所困,女兒又被人綁架。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 10 years ago, rescue team leader Zhang suffered the loss of his son in a landslide during a typhoon. His anguish leads to his wifes request for divorce. While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Jian, who rules China with the aid of sorcerer Hong Yi, is ill. His brother bribes Hong Yis confidant, Zhou Fang, in an attempt to seize the throne. Xiang Bai and Cai Ying fortuitously join Hong Yis club, and when Zhou Fang discovers the resemblance between Hong Yi and Cai Ying, she kidnaps Cai Ying in a conspiracy to fake Hong Yi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 茍勝、富貴等人突然在酒店遇到由食物引起的病毒爆發,感染者失去理智,瘋狂地撕咬其他人。茍勝帶領眾人逃離酒店,前往安全地方,在逃亡過程中與感染者發生了激烈搏鬥。隨後逃亡隊伍內部又突爆矛盾及衝突,互相猜忌。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gou and his friends encounter a food virus outbreak at the hotel, which causes infected people to bite others insanely. Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥,人族首領黃帝得奇門遁甲的力量終於平定世界,之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭周同因為被死對頭追殺,逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了周同,及後在霧..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金傲為保護中華傲決與無敵大戰,在生命垂危的時候將中華傲決傳授給華英雄。然而擁有“天煞孤星命格的華英雄失去了父母及妻子,離開了兒女,潛心修煉二十年卻始終無法參悟中華傲決。最終,華為了所有中國人要與無敵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jin Ao battles with Wu Di to preserve the Pride martial arts skill, which he passes to Hero Hua before he dies. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. Can Hua finally master the skill and defeats Wu Di to save his people?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前海外某安保公司的精英隊員韓彬,在一次保護任務時失敗,從此銷聲匿跡,頹廢終日。老拍檔希望韓能重新振作,在他極力邀請下,韓答應保護明星蘇曉琪前往東南亞某國拍攝節目。一路上,韓化解了多次威脅曉琪生命安全的..

His partner encourages Han to be his former self by escorting an actress to Southeast Asia to film a show. On the way, Han successfully deals with threats to the actress life, but realizes in the end that he is the one the evil gang has targeted!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛建成的洛陽宮夜裡被一條神龍縱火焚燒,木匠不是死就是失蹤。狄仁傑破格升任大理寺少卿查案,卻遭神秘勢力阻撓。他憑線索及隱士李先生的指點找到了關鍵人物宮少爺,也在紅顏知己柳月如協助下摧毀了機關基地。關鍵時..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The newly completed Luo Yang Palace is set to fire by the Fire Dragon, resulting in the carpenters being missing or dead. Detective Dee is tasked to investigate the case. He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 屠浮宮是東廠專門結交黨羽的朝庭禁地。大太監劉瑾為了得到大明藏寶圖,想借鑒賞寶物大會之名除掉與他不和的錦衣衛,卻被江湖人稱“盜聖一枝梅的沈鳶打亂。但沈鳶卻不幸受困,得到錦衣衛副指揮使周慕鋒的幫助脫險。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eunuch Liu plots to eliminate a rival imperial guard and seize a valuable treasure map. However, his plot is foiled by Thief Heroine, who is captured but later rescued by a deputy commander. The truth eventually reveals itself that it is all part of a conspiracy to unveil the secret of the Ming Dynastys hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在剿滅東南亞最大的犯罪組織救世會時,金泰在任務中誤殺了自己的師傅金銘。泰極度自責,默然離開特工組織。然而消失多年的救世會再次出現,泰更得知組織的頭目竟是死而復生的銘,令他一蹶不振,直到一個男孩的出現,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Secret agent Tai accidentally kills his master Ming, as he tries to destroy a powerful criminal gang. Tai is so guilty that he decides to leave the agency, but the gang with Master Ming as its head, reappear years later. Devastated by his masters deception, Tai returns as an agent to settle their grudges after being inspired by a young man.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在剿滅東南亞最大的犯罪組織救世會時,金泰在任務中誤殺了自己的師傅金銘。泰極度自責,默然離開特工組織。然而消失多年的救世會再次出現,泰更得知組織的頭目竟是死而復生的銘,令他一蹶不振,直到一個男孩的出現,..

Devastated by his masters deception, Tai returns as an agent to settle their grudges after being inspired by a young man.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靈蛇山白蛇與青蛇姊妹潛心修煉,某日白蛇遇險,幸得上山尋藥的許仙搭救,兩人之後一心相戀。然而人妖殊途,許仙被迫離開白蛇。陰司大妖王下令追捕白蛇。白蛇生命垂危卻將千年修行給了許仙,許仙自取心臟救回白蛇後自..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: White Snake and Green Snake devote themselves to attain immortality in a mountain. Xu Xian save White Snake one day and they fall in love. With demons and the underworld against them, both lovers sacrifice themselves to save the other. A hundred years later, White Snake give up on becoming an immortal and returned to the mortal world to find Xu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學狂人私下研發了一種具有交感神經、高度發達的人形機器人。偶然地,機器人獲得了獨立意識,更通過黑科技手段換取了貌美女子蘇辛的皮膚及軀殼,接近蘇的男友王升。另外,不斷有離奇殺人案發生,引起了警員李洞賓的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A science maniac creates an advanced humanlike robot, which accidentally develops its own thinking. It takes on the appearance of Susan by evil technology, and approaches her boyfriend. Meanwhile, police officer Li investigates a series of mysterious murder cases. A battle between humans and robots is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海神探張一人奉命到太平鎮調查一樁離奇兇案。村民們都傳是女鬼冤魂作祟,張在調查的過程中也接二連三有人遇害,跟著紙人勾魂、怨靈作祟的說法也悄然傳開。最終,張在當地乞丐狗子協助下把兇手繩之以法。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Zhang investigates a peculiar murder case in Taiping Town where villagers believe a female ghost is responsible. As Zhang investigates, more murders occur, sparking rumours of paper demons and vengeful wraiths. With the help of Beggar Gou Zi, Zhang finds the culprit and unveils the secret behind the serial murders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝崇禎末年,正派與魔教勢不兩立互有爭鬥。白髮魔女練霓裳因此陷入一場江湖的腥風血雨當中,內裡更蘊含著重大陰謀。錦衣衛常安奉命暗中調查白髮魔女練霓裳,在追查的道路上,常安對練霓裳產生了莫名的情愫,要為練..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新娘元如意在洞房花燭夜全家被殺,自己被一蒙面人救出。一年後,如意在消息販子包大庭口中得知,父親為救百姓當年殺死了一個賊寇,賊寇之子鐵背駝爺為報父仇血洗元家。在包的幫助下,如意尋找敵人的弱點,一個個剷除..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bride named Ru is the sole survivor of her familys massacre, and is rescued by a masked man. A year later, she learns from the newsmonger Bao that the massacre was orchestrated by a bandit who wants to avenges his fathers death caused by Rus father. With the help of Bao, Ru vanquishes the lackeys of the bandit and seeks her own vengeance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年的龍雲鎮,相傳鎮子發現寶藏後逐漸怪事不斷,接連出現少女家中被殺。同時,寶藏消息也招來各路心懷不軌的“江湖術士紛紛前來尋寶。巡捕隊的林隊長迫於鎮長壓力,決定聯手死刑犯計連營一起找出真凶及解開背..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of mysterious incidents happen when treasure is discovered in Long Yun Town, including killings of girls. As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

epg.programme_title_tc: 津沽奇譚1: 暗城殺機
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,津沽城命案接連發生,警局束手無策。一向以風水破案的段宇豪和祁威被要求調查此案以戴罪立功,免除之前的懲罰,但在找線索的同時,二人卻被一步步地推向多年前發生的羅剎鳥連環殺人案。段宇豪與祁..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In crime-ridden Jin Gu City, the police are unable to solve the murder cases. Duan Yu Hao and Qi Wei are assigned to investigate the cases through fortune-telling. In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傅炎為了拯救瀕臨死亡的藍墨伊,毅然前往上古戰場神佑之地,尋找神炎來救藍。上古戰場分三層,他們剛從外層降服了守護獸赤墨玄蛟時,便遇到蒼岩宗宗主蒼石靈君。然而傅及石二人要爭奪對方的半張藏寶圖,在一番激戰後..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: u sets out to find the Godly Flame and save the dying Nan. On his way, he encounters Master Shi of Can Yan Sect when vanquishing a guardian beast. Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. Both decide to share the map and team up to search for the treasure and the Godly Flame.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 趙子龍在常山歸隱七年後,因戰亂變故流落到鄴城與劉備及趙雲重逢。趙子龍終究被劉備的仁義所折服,在劉備與眾人的鼓勵及殘酷現實的鞭策之下,逐漸找回自我與理想,再次號召眾兄弟並肩作戰,最終在長阪坡大敗敵軍,成..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hiding in Mount Zhang for seven years,  Zhao Zi Long reunites with Liu Bei and Zhao Yun. Persuaded by Lius righteousness, Zhao rediscovers his aspirations and rallies his comrades to battle their enemies at Chang Ban Slope. He eventually defeats the enemies and emerges as the Great General of the Han Dynasty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林大會時,盟主霍長空與血魔羅決戰時輸了,血魔亦元氣大傷,危急關頭霍將功力注入劉晶體內,劉意外獲得內力。十四年後,劉在隅然機會下來到“霍家拳館,陰差陽錯遇到血魔羅重出江湖找霍家人報仇。有著霍長空功力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Defeated by Blood Demon in a martial arts tournament, Master Huo passes his skills to young Liu Jing. Fourteen years later, Liu chances upon Huos martial arts school and meets Blood Demon who returns for vengeance against Huos clan. Liu fights Blood Demon with Huos legendary skills, upholding justice and protecting Huos clan in a deadly battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,生活在洛陽洛河水兩端但不同出生的兩個少女意外被捲入懸案之中。一位是金吾衛隊長的女兒趙青青,另一位是生於市井底層的女孩小騙子。她們一同遭遇在洛陽城內一連串匪夷所思的離奇案件,二人組成了臨時搭檔..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Zhou dynasty, two girls living in two ends of the Luo He River come from diverse backgrounds - one is a captains daughter and another is a common swindler - and they encounter a series of mysterious events in Luo Yang City. Both team up to investigate a series of bizarre cases, to uphold justice and to maintain order amidst a social upheaval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊,由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡,趕去營救,卻聽到槍響,之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊的一段,跟著一聲槍響,被擊中頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓渺是八仙之一韓湘子的化身,在一個缺水猶如沙漠的世界一路向東歷練。而正在執掌東海的龍女因失去記憶,化成了一條魚精,意外遇到和自己有宿世因緣的韓渺。二人走在一起,在東遊途中受到高人指點去尋找 “龍門 ..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Han Miao is one of the eight immortals living in a desert. Dragon Maiden, who helms the East Ocean, loses her memory and becomes a fish demon. When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. With help from a guru, they set out for Dragon Gate where Dragon Maiden can resume her identity and locate the water source.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 利欲熏心的地產商為了開發蛇王島,重金收買以金老四為首的黑市捕蛇團夥,企圖登島滅蛇。與此同時,身為養蛇家族後人的陳崢與動物保護專家周曉曉及馬奮,為了印證泰坦巨蟒存在的傳說,亦到島上搜集資料。陳崢等人為了..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A greedy property developer bribes a snake catcher gang to eradicate serpents on King Serpent Island for profit. Meanwhile, the snake clans descendant and two animal protection experts venture to the island to confirm the existence of the legendary Titan Snake, resulting in a fierce battle with the ruthless gang to preserve the islands ecology.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青山大學著名植物學教授霍玉春研發出一種可以讓植物與動物DNA相結合的新病毒。此時女學生羅柯向教授的助教鄭問表白,兩人墜入愛河之際,病毒突然在學校中爆發,柯不幸受感染被隔離。為了拯救學校及柯,鄭問找到教..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huo, a famous university botany professor, uses animal and plant DNAs to develop a virus. His assistant, Cheng, falls in love with his student, Ke, but Ke gets infected during a sudden virus outbreak in the university. To save Ke and the university, Cheng stumbles upon the professors secret laboratory and unveils a secret between Huo and Ke.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 錦毛鼠白玉堂因不滿展昭被賜禦貓封號,同結拜兄弟“陷空島五鼠在東京火神節上盜取火神像,以此羞辱負責巡防治安的展昭。不料二人在爭搶火神像時,祭祀大典和整個煙花坊突起水澆不滅的大火,無辜百姓被燒成灰燼。白..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Upset by Constable Zhangs prestigious title of Imperial Cat, Bai and his sworn brother steal a god statue during the Tokyo God of Fire Festival to embarass Zhang. Tragedy strikes as a fire breaks out, claiming innocent lives. Bai and Zhang join forces to investigate the truth behind the incident and vow to take down the real culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,生物研究所得知在沙海有異變生物,於是派出探索小隊前往調查,但前去的隊員幾乎全部被滅,剩下劉夢西和夏萱帶著生物樣本逃離,過程非常危險,幸得獲沙丘鎮柳纓所救。原來沙漠出現異獸,居民被迫在地底生活..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Institute of Biology assigns a team to investigate the mutants in a desert, but the whole team is nearly wiped out. Luckily, two researchers escape with the mutants samples. As the residents in the desert are forced to live underground to avoid threats by the mutants, the team must beat the mutants for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,生物研究所得知在沙海有異變生物,於是派出探索小隊前往調查,但前去的隊員幾乎全部被滅,剩下劉夢西和夏萱帶著生物樣本逃離,過程非常危險,幸得獲沙丘鎮柳纓所救。原來沙漠出現異獸,居民被迫在地底生活..

Luckily, two researchers escape with the mutants samples. As the residents in the desert are forced to live underground to avoid threats by the mutants, the team must beat the mutants for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毒梟塚虎在十五年前派人追殺梅姨,當時林郎與林峰親眼目睹母親梅姨被殺害,為躲避殺手追殺,郎與峰分頭走散,但郎之後音訊全無,而峰成為緝毒員警。在中國邊境滇市的掃毒行動中,峰發現毒梟郎哥的母親也是被塚虎殺害..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Lang and Lin Feng witness their mothers murder by the drug dealer Tiger fifteen years ago. They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,一代奇人關師爺行走江湖,巧遇狐妖鬧事。關師爺與狐妖鬥法,過程中認識了逢賭必輸的葉飛。此事過後,關師爺又巧妙化解了一樁青樓恩怨,為死去的冤者伸冤,卻再次與怪事纏身的葉飛相遇。之後二人攜手與妖怪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, demon catcher Guan meets Ye Fei, a gambler who always loses, when he fights against the fox demon. Guan meets the troubled Ye Fei again after he resolves a case involving innocent deaths in a brothel, and they team up to successfully fight against the demons and evil spirits with their wit and bravery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,自稱是捉鬼大師的豪哥和他的兩個徒弟雖然有點真功夫,卻多數靠小聰明以詐騙為生。直至鎮上真的發生了離奇事件,他們終能發揮所長,憑藉自身的聰明才智和高強武功,遂一破解小鎮殭屍作亂玄案,並一併剷除鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A self-declared ghost buster Hao, and his two disciples, possess good skills but resort to fraud ghost hunting skills to make money. When mysterious incidents happen in town, they can finally unleash their skills to solve the mystery of the vampire case and exterminate the evil sects by using their wits and martial arts skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上古時期,魔族首領蚩尤擾亂天庭,最終被打回原形,天尊把他貶為凡人,及賜給他仁慈的心。數年後,蚩尤體內的魔性被別有用心的人喚醒,他便前往昆侖尋求解封方法。蚩尤途中結識了火焰山公主葉瀟瀟,二人情愫漸生,而..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in ancient times, leader of the demon tribe, Chi You, causes chaos in heaven and is demoted to become a kind human. When Chi Yous evil power awakens years later, he find ways to break his seal in Kun Lun, where he meets a princess and fall in love. Through perilous trials, Chi You and the princess unravel the truth behind a conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少男曾為獲得格鬥冠軍的哥哥少北為驕傲,以為有哥哥在便能永遠保護自己,可以像少年時一樣無憂無慮。最終哥哥在衝刺世界格鬥冠軍擂臺上身受重傷意外身亡。格鬥公司創辦人丹姐訓練少男幫助他復仇,而少男亦替少北贏回..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shao Nan is proud of his brother Shao Bai being the combat fighting champion. When Shao Bei died after being seriously injured in a fight, the founder of the fight company decides to train Shao Nan for vengeance. Shao Nan eventually rises to become the next champion, fulfilling his brothers last wish and make Asians proud.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊防部隊正在追蹤國內最大毒梟組織旭東商會的一批價值數百萬美元的毒品,卻被劉老三團夥搶走。警方找到在監獄服刑劉的兄弟大飛,說服他幫忙找回毒品。組織老大黃旭東知道貨被搶,便找了國際僱傭軍準備捉人搶貨。邊防..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Border troops are after a multi-million dollar drug deal from the biggest drug dealer but Lius gang snatches the drug away. As the police seeks help from the prisoner Da Fei, who is Lius friend, the drug lord also hires mercenaries to get the drugs back. A battle between the border troops, the triad and the mercenaries has just started!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年前,一顆外太空隕石載著三顆晶瑩玉石墜落人間一村莊,傳聞任何人進入此村莊的森林都會遇到山鬼,而從沒人能成功走出來。二十年後傳說中的山鬼又再次出現,而且引發了多宗血案。當案件被深入調查時,原本被掩蓋..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two decades ago, a meteorite carrying three crystals struck a village on Earth. Rumor has it that anyone entering the village forest will be haunted by a mountain ghost and trapped. After 20 years, the ghost reappears, causing a series of murders. As investigation begins, the hidden truth behind the mystery is gradually uncovered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漁民子豪生活在海邊小鎮歸港,以捕魚為生。有一天,他偶然遇到一位神秘的女孩小藝,兩人互生情愫,終於走在一起。但好景不長,突然有一個名叫老金的神秘中年人到來,揭開了小藝真實的身份竟然是人魚族!子豪能否接受..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love.  However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day.  Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年青鐵匠呂三思偶遇自己崇拜的大俠百里無憂。他幫助大俠押送西廠走狗何清纓,但何卻對他說了另一個版本的故事,說她是被西廠迫害,而百里才是出賣義士的走狗!事情越來越可疑,何不一定是走狗,而百里也可能不是大俠..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young blacksmith Lui encounters his idol, Swordsman Bai Li, and helps Bai deport He Qing Ying, a lackey of the emperors secret agency. However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漫畫展上,宅男漫畫家郝萍穹意外與殺手肖白菜交換了身體。穹由廢柴變成擁有豐滿身材和超能力的少女,但他卻不斷被壞人追殺。白菜不用擔心受敵人襲擊,但她卻每天過著被追稿的生活。這換位人生讓他們更了解自己的能力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bottom-ranking cartoonist Hao and killer Xiao accidentally swapped identities at a comic fair. Hao becomes a powerful girl but is pursued by villains, while Xiao is free from pursuit but must work on deadlines everyday. After knowing their capabilites and responsibilities, they resume their identities and team up to fight the villains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 神州名將李追風在北坡城被薩滿十萬大軍包圍。為了救出李和一眾將士,黃自在將軍組織了八百人隊伍前往營救,在經過重重險阻後終於救出李將軍,並且為了拖延薩滿士兵而甘願留下來鎮守北坡城,等待李將軍帶援軍趕來。最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Huang leads 800 warriors to rescue General Li and other generals trapped by the 100,000 Sha Men troops in Bai Po City. He successfully saved General Li after overcoming various dangers, and stalled Sha Men forces as they await troop reinforcements.  In the end, General Li and the 800 warriors heroically safeguard their homeland.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武狀元蘇燦在打擊販賣大煙的天門教鬥爭中意外受傷失憶,流落街頭淪為蘇乞兒,及後被金枝和小果母女收留。小果意外發現了配製好的鴉片膏,被天門教捉走。蘇乞兒為了救小果及避免鴉片禍害百姓,一舉破壞了天門教的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Top martial artist Su Can lost his memory in a battle with the opium seller, Tian Men Cult. He becomes a beggar and is taken in by a mother and her daughter. The daughter is caught by the cult when she accidentally discovers the opium. Beggar Su joins the court to save the girl and destroy the cult, so as to stop the opiums harm on people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 普通青年朗俊在一次送貨過程中意外受傷,卻成了黑暗勢力“三羽聯的實驗品。他被變為半狼人,擁有了超能力。在成功逃走後,朗得躲避“三羽聯的追殺,在過程中他偶然發現了父親死亡的真相。為了尋找身體變異的原因..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lang Jun is injured during a delivery and subsequently becomes a guinea pig in a gangs lab experiment, transforming into a super powered werewolf. After his escape, Lang uncovers the truth behind his fathers death, and must fight against the gangsters to unravel the cause of his mutation and protect his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇門派和五毒派為江湖兩大門派,而這兩大派為了“皇家龍種花落誰家而各施各法,奇門派誤打誤撞中揭穿了皇叔試圖阻止皇帝有子嗣的陰謀。皇叔派五毒派弟子秀明試圖毒害皇太子,而奇門則派出多美。多美為人善良,且鍾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qimen and Wudu Cults both get involved in the imperial succession plan. Qimen Cult accidentally uncovers the conspiracy of the Emperors uncle, who enlists a Wudu disciple to poison the Crown prince. Meanwhile, Qimens Duo Mei falls for a royal guard and joins forces with him to uncover the evil plot of the emperors uncle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以阿古力為首的狼衛軍攻打硫勒城,企圖得到竊天氏的龍脈寶藏和天下第一美人將軍史天驕。守城將軍史萬夫寡不敵眾,與好友肖不平密謀,利用《竊天書》設計反攻狼衛軍。史為了擊退狼衛軍,拯救自己的女兒和全城百姓,竟..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wolf Guard Army invades the city to seize the treasure of Qie Tian Clan and to capture a beautiful female general. Though largely outnumbered, General Shi and his friend Shao plot to counterattack the Wolf Guard Army. To rescue his daughter and the people, Shi decapitates himself continues to battle the enemies as a headless general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凡人體質的修仙者傅炎在前往上古戰場途中,遇到空間裂縫,掉落在一個名為獸人域的地方。這裡的九宫森林妖獸遍地,他一路擊殺妖獸尋找出口,途中結識了丹聖林踏天。林幫助傅走出森林,並傳授他煉丹之術。走出森林後,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A seeker of immortality, Fu falls through a rift into the realm of monsters on way to an ancient battlefield. As he fights his way out, Fu meets Master Lin who helps him flee and imparts skills to him. After he leaves the forest, Fu witnesses the reincarnation of the spider demon, and commences his thrilling immortal journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凡人體質的修仙者傅炎在前往上古戰場途中,遇到空間裂縫,掉落在一個名為獸人域的地方。這裡的九宫森林妖獸遍地,他一路擊殺妖獸尋找出口,途中結識了丹聖林踏天。林幫助傅走出森林,並傳授他煉丹之術。走出森林後,..

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弟弟杜家豪在上水鎮被水猴子殘殺,民國女法醫清伶為了探尋真相便前往上水鎮探尋原因。在這詭異的村莊,關於水猴子復仇的“詛咒接二連三發生。清伶携槍勇闖水怪禁地黑木林,而她力憑科學文明剷除水猴子的封建迷信,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brothers murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上陽郡主王萱在與寒族將軍蕭霽新婚之夜,為遵守與愛人三皇子子珩的約定,甘願飲毒酒假死,豈料這一切只是皇權氏族的陰謀算計。王萱傷透了心,為了報仇化身為吸食人血的修羅女,連子珩對她也非常懼怕。然而蕭霽卻對王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Princess Wang fakes death on her wedding day with General Xiao to fulfil her vow with her secret lover. After realizing it was a set up by the Emperor, Wang is devastated and turns into a blood demon to take revenge. However, General Xiao still stands by her side and helps her to uncover the truth behind an even bigger conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了取長補短,陳真遠赴日本學習工業技術。留學期間,陳真與擅長形意拳的武術家薛自立一起,為了捍衛中國人民的尊嚴,他們勇敢面對日本軍部官員的比武挑戰。一場中國功夫大師與日本武士的較量正式上演,比武場上陳真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen travels to Japan to learn industrial technology, he teams up with martial artist She Zi Li, and accepts a duel challenge from the Japanese military officials to uphold the Chinese dignity. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正邪之首,龍門及異門在昆侖之巔決戰,異門被滅,龍門首領朗炎建立龍都城,並設立龍雀衛組織。轉眼十二年後,突然朗遭蜘蛛人襲擊中毒,龍雀衛首領方圓及聖女姬心在調查襲擊事件的過程中,發現異門後人利用噬魂蜘蛛企..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leaders of Long Sect and Yi Sect battled and the Yi Sect was defeated. 12 years later, Lang Yan, Long Sects leader, is poisoned by the spider demon. As Longs guard and Ji Xin investigate the case, they uncover a plot by Yis descendants to unleash spider demons onto Long to create chaos. The battle between good and evil will soon begin....

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群偷獵者在公海上對鯊魚進行殘酷的捕殺,激怒了大白鯊。偷獵者死於鯊魚的口中,之後盛怒的大白鯊把注意力轉向了在附近遊艇上慶祝畢業的四個好友。於是,四人與大白鯊之間展開了一場激烈的生死搏鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A big white shark is enraged following a shark hunt by the poachers, who are then killed by it. Fueled by anger, the shark turns to attack four friends who are celebrating their graduation on a yacht. A life-and-death struggle between the four friends and the big white shark has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋遼太平時期,原本是秘密組織“鳳火軍培養的特工唐紫煙被安插在京都皇城司任職。正當唐紫煙想悄悄退出,與丈夫過上平靜的餘生時,丈夫卻被鳳凰火軍帶走來威脅唐接受新任務,刺殺來訪的北朝特使皇太弟。唐決心脫離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agent Tang is trained by the secret society to work undercover in the imperial government. Tang wants to quit for a peaceful life with her husband but is forced to kill the Imperial Prince when the society holds her husband hostage. Tang resolves to break free and joins forces with the Imperial Prince to destroy the society and restore peace.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在幫派紛爭中銷聲匿跡的龍頭阿暿向來獨來獨往,武功了得,更是霍氏醉拳的高手。阿暿隱姓埋名化身為懲治惡勢力的俠客。而行事殘暴的軍閥霄霸天與黑虎山山匪勾結,成立壓榨當地貧民的茶廠 來幫他們種植鴉片。阿暿..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cult leader Ah Xi is a top martial artist who is also a skilled Huo Drunken Fist fighter. However, she chooses to become an incognito swordswoman who fights against evil. Warlord Xiao Ba Tin colludes with some bandits and force the poor to plant opium. Ah Xi steps up to fight against them and finally exterminate the evil gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蘅王統治下民不聊生,有志之士誓要推翻蘅王,立下衣帶詔。蘅王請魏侯爺找出衣帶詔,並要派殺手殺死名單上所有人。白山水和謝柔均在名單上,而謝柔的弟弟謝長勝對白心生愛慕,與其他殺手一路追蹤白到客棧。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the oppressive rule of Emperor Heng, some volunteers sign on the Belt Oath to overthrow the government. The Emperor sends killers to eliminate them, including Bai Shan Sui and Xie Rou. Xies brother falls for Bai, so he follows the killers to the inn, but ends up causing a series of hilarious events due to misunderstandings.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青雲堂的女掌門於勝男為了完成病重父親的願望,急於結婚。她在相親時認識了牛多多,而牛在威逼利誘下簽了假結婚協議。正當勝男漸漸被牛的善良和純真吸引,多年前被勝男父親逐出師門的師兄林傑歸來,並用牛威脅勝男接..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yu Sheng Nan rushes to get married to fulfil her dying fathers wish and forces Niu, a man she just knew, to sign a bogus marriage agreement. As Yu gradually falls for Niu, her expelled senior returns and forces Yu to accept his duel challenge by threatening her with Nius safety. A deadly martial arts fight has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 初任上海警察隊長的陳虎接到一樁命案,軍政部部長之子何滿君離奇死亡。何是聖馬丁高中的一名學生,為了獲得破案信息,陳喬裝學生混入學校。他一邊查案,一邊與各方勢力展開較量,而何之死迷霧重重,一個又一個嫌疑人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The son of a minister is mysteriously killed. The newly appointed police inspector Chen Fu, goes undercover as a secondary student to investigate the case. As he carries on investigation in the school, Chen encounters different potential suspects, making the case more mysterious. What is the cause of the murder and who is the killer?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公即將在突破最後一層成為降龍羅漢的關鍵時刻,感應到白水鎮村民有難,於是他放棄修行前往白水鎮解救百姓。在這裡他遇到了假扮濟公的黃元蠱惑百姓,差點把濟公燒死,但最終黃元被濟公所感化,並幫助濟公一起降魔伏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ji Gong is about to transform into the Arhat when he foresees a threat to the villagers in town and decides to sacrifice his practice to rescue them. He encounters Huang, who impersonates him and bewitches the villagers, leading Ji Gong to be nearly burnt alive. When Huang is finally enlightened by Ji Gong, he joins him to subdue the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人,團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛,公司主要是保護客戶安全,俗稱“保鏢。這天,他們接到一個匿名委託,要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸,之後逸便頻生意外。童發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期上海,怪物獵人宇文預測到上豪大飯店有怪獸出現,而當怪獸現身襲擊表演的花旦顧青時,宇文英雄救美,打斷富少警探天明的公開表白。之後三人被捲入了一系列的奇怪案件,在調查過程中,所有線索都指向一個塵封..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican time in Shanghai, monster hunter Yu saves an actress in a play from a monsters attack, at the same time interrupting a cops love confession for her. As the trio gets involved in a series of mysterious cases, they find out that the cases are related to a legend about a giant monster who will soon be returning to the world...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1990年的東北,年輕氣盛的私營小巴司機徐鐵愛上了家境優渥的陳麗莎,因為現實差距,二人的關係遭到麗莎的母親反對。為了賺錢,徐鐵誤入歧途,導致了身邊人的犧牲。在家人和朋友的幫助下,徐鐵終浪子回頭,明白了..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young minibus driver Xu Tie falls for a rich girl Lisa. However, Lisas mother disapproves of Xu due to their social differences. Xu Tie goes astray in the hope of earning more money, but ends up harming his friends. With the support of family and friends, Xu Tie tries to make amends and begins to appreciate love and life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東南亞最大人口販賣組織頭目巴頌在自己的私人俱樂部設宴,邀請世界各地犯罪集團的頭目參加。雅美成功潛入俱樂部執行任務,為了掩護隊友撤退,美獨自引爆炸彈,與未婚夫方立一起裝死後隱居。三年後方立被綁架,迫雅美..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Asias biggest human trafficker Ba Song, invites the triad bosses to attend his private party. Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東南亞最大人口販賣組織頭目巴頌在自己的私人俱樂部設宴,邀請世界各地犯罪集團的頭目參加。雅美成功潛入俱樂部執行任務,為了掩護隊友撤退,美獨自引爆炸彈,與未婚夫方立一起裝死後隱居。三年後方立被綁架,迫雅美..
