epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talents are found everywhere in the Tang dynasty, including Blind man Cheng. He meets a barmaid Ni Yan, who has lost her family and gotten abused, and they become friends. This entangles Cheng into a big triad conflict, and as he starts his journey of revenge, his true identity is also revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次打擊邊境犯罪的行動中,特種兵王周揚、肖克二人參與了邊境黑勢力清剿活動,卻遭遇戰友慘死,此後兩人陷入深深的不安和自責中。及後在一次面對黑勢力的逆襲時,兩人決定再度聯手,共同對抗敵人。一場正義與邪惡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a mission to extinguish the cross border gangs, Zhou Yang and Xiao Ke of the special task force witness the tragic death of their comrades and feel greatly disturbed and guilty. However, in a counterattack by the gangs, Zhou and Xiao team up again to fight against the gangs.  A final battle between the good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南方一座城市中突發一起爆炸危機事件,排爆特警在第一時間展開迅速救援和周密偵破。為排除其他爆炸隱患,守護群眾安全,特警馬進和朱江等人衝鋒在前,不斷化解炸彈危機。排爆隊員在全城展開排爆行動與犯罪分子之間..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a sudden explosion in the city, the anti-explosion team dashes to the scene to rescue and investigate. Led by Officer Ma and Officer Zhu, they prioritize peoples safety and set out to prevent further explosions. Tension mounts as the situation becomes increasingly volatile. Can the team defeat the odds and bring an end to the crisis?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔刀門女弟子雅青初次下山,不慎捲入唐門“蛇人風波,在逃避追殺的途中結識了啞女伏風和江若晨。正當他們陷入絕境時,幸得隱居高人梁玄卿指點知道“蛇人之謎背後隱藏著一個大陰謀。為了尋找真相,三個人齊心協力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Magic Blade Sects disciple Ya Qing gets implicated in a snakeman trouble and meets two girls during her escape from a killer. The three girls are told by a master about the conspiracy behind the snakeman. To uncover the truth, they team up to defeat the mastermind of the conspiracy and unveil the grudges in the elder generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年後的未來世界,一群食客打算去一家違法經營的野味飯店享受一頓野味大餐,突然當中有一隻變種巨蜥衝破了鐵籠逃走,之後店員一個接一個地神秘失蹤。在此同時捕鼠專家阿發接到飯店的滅鼠委託,本來的滅鼠行動卻變..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2040s, a group of customers visits an illegal restaurant serving wild animal meat. Suddenly, a giant lizard mutant escapes from the cage and the restaurant staff disappears one by one. Meanwhile, a rat catcher is tasked by the restaurant to exterminate rats, but it turns out to be a terrifying battle against the lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多年前九龍黑幫頭目章山河因與人火拼而入獄,此時妻子亦因難產而亡,留下女兒。章出獄後,決定放棄黑幫舊業,獨自撫養女兒。然而章為救昔日兄弟,卻導致黑幫老大塔里意外身亡,因此引來塔的弟弟查儂報復,殺死了他的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Triad boss Zhang was jailed when his wife died after giving birth to their daughter. When Zhang is released, he decides to quit the triad and take care of his daughter but accidentally kills the triad boss. Ta Lis brother, Cha, takes revenge by kidnapping Zhangs daughter, resulting in a deadly battle between the two men.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金傲為保護中華傲決與無敵大戰,在生命垂危的時候將中華傲決傳授給華英雄。然而擁有“天煞孤星命格的華英雄失去了父母及妻子,離開了兒女,潛心修煉二十年卻始終無法參悟中華傲決。最終,華為了所有中國人要與無敵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jin Ao battles with Wu Di to preserve the Pride martial arts skill, which he passes to Hero Hua before he dies. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. Can Hua finally master the skill and defeats Wu Di to save his people?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上古時期,因人類的貪念欲望所生成的魔王阿爾薩召集亡靈軍團征服了世界,而上古人類領袖以鮮血鑄成聖劍封印了阿爾薩。千百年後,阿爾薩破開封印,開始在東原大陸發起進攻。此時聖殿騎士團聯合東方巡夜山宮等武林門派..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In ancient times, Demon King Artha summons the dead spirit army to conquer the world, but is sealed by the holy sword. Thousand years later, Artha breaks the seal and launches an attack to the east. The holy chevaliers unite with the martial arts cults to find the holy sword, hoping to seal Artha again and save the people from his tyrannical reign.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十世紀90年代末的哈爾濱,于鐵在替人收債時,對借貸人的女兒金佳麗一見鍾情。鐵雖然是收債人,但他為人講義氣、心地善良及認真對待感情的態度,終於打動了麗。可惜鐵突如其來的頭痛,加上與收債組織的大哥在處事..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the late 90s in Harbin, Tie falls for Li while collecting debts from her father. Li is touched by Ties loyalty, kindness and desire for true love. Unfortunately, a sudden headache hits Tie and he gets into an argument with the boss of the debt collection agency, putting more strain on the relationship of the two lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 霍元甲年少氣盛,認為武術為重。為了在天津的武館立足,他連續打敗了七家武館,在對戰大刀王五的徒弟幽蘭時,卻遭到朝廷勢力袁庭山的陷害。與此同時,霍負責護送維新首領譚先生回京城。在這次驚心動魄的任務中,他逐..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Huo Yuan Jia loves marital arts. He defeats seven martial arts school masters to establish himself in Tianjin, but is set up by a court official during a tournament. When Huo escorts a revolutionary leader to the capital, he finally understands that the country and its people are the ultimate purpose for practising martial arts.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐朝末年,崑崙山昆吾閣長老的皇甫察覺到妖族破壞龍脈,便帶領弟子們前去與千年樹妖鬥法。樹妖吸收了魔物萬魄玄陰珠後實力大增,在激鬥中眾人損傷殆盡。此時皇耗盡法力啟動飛流法陣,將大弟子尋荼與女弟子楚靈兒送回..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kun Lun Master Huang and his disciples fight against the Thousand Year Tree Demon who seeks to eliminate the Emperors heir. The demon becomes powerful after taking in a sorcerous pill, causing deaths and injuries. Huang then uses his power to send his disciples back in time, hoping that the demon can be conquered before the pill was taken.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太平洋的某處孤島上建立了一座沒有法律限製的「無罪之城」,眾多犯罪分子慕名前往,以求庇護。國際特種兵唐柯在無罪之城執行任務時不幸落入索蘭的圈套,逃生時發現自己體內被注射毒劑,生命只剩下幾小時。面對妻子被..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Innocent City is built on an isolated island with no laws set in place and many criminals go there for shelter. Tang, of the special forces, is trapped by Solan during his mission, and though he escapes, he is poisoned and has few hours to live. As Solan also kills Tang’s wife and kidnaps his daughter, Tang embarks on a road to revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 茍勝、富貴等人突然在酒店遇到由食物引起的病毒爆發,感染者失去理智,瘋狂地撕咬其他人。茍勝帶領眾人逃離酒店,前往安全地方,在逃亡過程中與感染者發生了激烈搏鬥。隨後逃亡隊伍內部又突爆矛盾及衝突,互相猜忌。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gou and his friends encounter a food virus outbreak at the hotel, which causes infected people to bite others insanely. Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 墨家機關術嫡系傳人沈拓接受無極監獄典獄長的邀請,與六名隊友進入機關城最底部,尋找墨家磁石,打開監獄機關。但墨家機關在城內佈局千變萬化,傳言至今從未有人能夠活著出來。沈拓為了救出妻子姜刃,及讓監獄里的人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shen Tuo, a descendant of Mohist Mechanism, is invited by the prison chief to find a magnet in the prison basement with a team of six. However, there is a rumour that no one can leave the basement alive. Determined to save his wife and free the prisoners, Shen embarks on a dangerous journey through the citys labyrinth of mechanism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏年間,新君登基,時局未穩,遊牧民族柔然對魏國虎視眈眈。為牽制柔然,大魏公主和親北涼,不料卻被柔然猛將綿爾圖擄走。綿挾持公主,要魏國在兩日內交出十座城池為贖金。魏國將軍花木蘭臨危受命,更啟用死囚慕容..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Northern Wei empire faces raids from the nomadic Rou Ran tribe. The princess of Wei is kidnapped by a Rou Ran general, who demands ten cities as ransom. Weis General Mulan forms a special task force to rescue the princess and a fatal battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗美援朝戰爭時期,志願軍三排排長孟大關臨危受命,帶領小隊前去解救被困敵後的偵察排。經歷了一系列艱難險阻,孟與由杜川帶領的偵察排終於成功匯合。為了避免部隊有更大傷亡,孟與杜在危急關頭果斷決定,要困死那個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meng, a Volunteer Army platoon leader, is commissioned to rescue a platoon in captive. Through arduous trials, Meng teams up with another platoon leader, Du. They decide to contain the enemys artillery supply to reduce casualties, and vow to dedicate themselves to fight against the foes for their people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥,人族首領黃帝得奇門遁甲的力量終於平定世界,之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭周同因為被死對頭追殺,逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了周同,及後在霧..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 屠浮宮是東廠專門結交黨羽的朝庭禁地。大太監劉瑾為了得到大明藏寶圖,想借鑒賞寶物大會之名除掉與他不和的錦衣衛,卻被江湖人稱“盜聖一枝梅的沈鳶打亂。但沈鳶卻不幸受困,得到錦衣衛副指揮使周慕鋒的幫助脫險。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eunuch Liu plots to eliminate a rival imperial guard and seize a valuable treasure map. However, his plot is foiled by Thief Heroine, who is captured but later rescued by a deputy commander. The truth eventually reveals itself that it is all part of a conspiracy to unveil the secret of the Ming Dynastys hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在罪惡橫行的世界裡,有一個叫太平鎮的桃花源。這裡有私人英雄守護而未被黑幫入侵。吳正義為了成為私人英雄的一員,每天苦練功夫,在正義救星中心雄先生的幫助下成為私人英雄。隨後他發現該鎮被邪惡集團控制,最終與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亂世末期,商朝遭到周武王的進攻,被周軍將領楊戩打得節節敗退。軍師申公豹向紂王建議招攬梅山七怪助商攻周,因為七怪之首袁洪與楊戩一樣精通八九玄功可七十二變。紂王命申公豹立刻前往梅山將七怪納入麾下。於是,楊..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Zhou Wu has defeated the Shang empire with General Yang defeating the Shang army. Military advisor Shen advises Emperor Shang to recruit Seven Monsters with mystic skills to attack Zhou, so Emperor Shang orders his general to find Seven Monsters in Mountain Mei. The battle between Zhou and Shang has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張宸是軍事戰術教官,經常輾轉於世界各地為安保公司做戰術培訓。一次意外中,張被捲入一宗謀殺案,成了當地的通緝犯。張被迫逃亡,並在同伴初五的幫助下找到了謀殺案倖存者黛米。三人相互配合,開始著手調查,在槍林..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Military instructor Zhang Zhen accidentally gets involved in a murder and becomes the suspect. He is forced to flee and with the help of his companion, Zhang finds the sole survivor of the murder. The trio launches an investigation and strives to uncover the truth, which seems to be connected to a human smuggling gang and a military organization.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,禦史中丞胡顯德一家被殺,武則天派狄仁傑前往調查。狄調查發現,原本老實本分的胡離奇般參與了一場大案,此案可能是一宗案中案。在查案過程中,狄不斷遇見各種詭異事件,更有陰兵索命的傳言,案件一籌莫展..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Di Ren Jie is assigned by Empress Wu to investigate the massacre of Minister Hus family. In the process, he uncovers Hus involvement in a criminal case and encounters spooky incidents, as well as rumours of vengeful killing by hell guards. Di delves into the heart of the perplexing mystery, unravelling the truth behind it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來的地球資源匱乏,各國頂尖科學家將數種動植物的物種送往火星培養,希望改善火星的環境能夠適合人類居住。然而生物在實驗中開始發生變異攻擊人類,身在火星的專家們情況十分危險。中國派出太空人進行救援,他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有妖怪殺手之稱的劉一刀為了給妹妹治病,不惜退隱江湖四處尋訪名醫。此時以蛇女和金蟾子為首的妖族,正密謀危害人間。後來劉陰差陽錯遇到錦鯉精小巒,得知她是黑龍轉世。妖族亦知道此事,也想爭奪小巒帶她去召喚..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon killer Liu Yi Dao retires from the martial arts world to find a doctor for his ailing sister. Meanwhile, the demon clan is plotting against the human world. Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事圍繞著用生命來維護世間陰陽平衡的陽冥司端木熙,與遭遇車禍意外死去的漫畫屋老闆楊敬華。楊陰差陽錯被迫與端簽訂終身契約,成為端的影靈,二人互相看不慣對方,卻被契約緊緊捆綁在一起。之後連續發生詭異的死亡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a story about a ghost hunter, Duan, who is dedicated to maintaining the yin-yang balance and a comic store owner, Yang, who dies in a car accident. Yang becomes a spirit attached to Duan through a lifetime contract.  Initially at odds, they unite to entangle the mysteries of recurring bizzare deaths and restore peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天后武則天壽宴之際,房州城發生“赤目怪物傷人事件。狄仁傑奉命與不良人沈青青及徒弟陳江橋結成探案分隊前往調查,而所有證據似乎都表明幕後主謀正是被廢太子李顯,但狄卻敏銳地發現真相絕非如此簡單,背後蘊藏著..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Red-Eye Monster attacks Fang Zhou City on Empress Wus birthday. Detective Dee is assigned to investigate the case. While all clues apparently point to the deposed prince, Detective Dee realizes that there is a conspiracy behind. Together with another investigation team, Detective Dee finally unravels the truth of the mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀七十年代,香港在英國殖民統治下貪腐嚴重,黑惡勢力橫行,毒梟坤哥及豪哥大賺不義之財。廉政公署人員白玫瑰奉命潛伏到黑幫大佬豪哥身邊收集罪證。玫瑰與豪哥日漸熟識,兩人互生情愫。面對一面是將毒梟繩之以法..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Drug lords Kun and Hao prosper amidst a corrupt landscape in the 1970s Hong Kong. ICAC officer Rose embarks on a mission to infiltrate Haos gang to gather evidence. However, as Rose and Hao fall in love, she faces a heart-wrenching dilemma — choosing between her duty to bring him down and the irresistible pull of their intensifying romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海上救難隊員阿傑為了生計及克服之前同伴遇難的陰影,再次乘坐漁船出海謀生,卻再次遭遇巨大的危機。在船上的人不僅要面對惡劣的暴雨天氣,還有海底未知生物正對著他們虎視眈眈。在茫茫大海中,猙獰相對的眾人更必須..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navy officer Ah Jie returns to the fleet to earn a living and tries to recover from the trauma of his comrades death. The fleet encounters severe rainstorm and has to face an unknown sea creature. In the face of adversity, everyone on board must overcome the challenges to trust and support each other in order to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年的龍雲鎮,相傳鎮子發現寶藏後逐漸怪事不斷,接連出現少女家中被殺。同時,寶藏消息也招來各路心懷不軌的“江湖術士紛紛前來尋寶。巡捕隊的林隊長迫於鎮長壓力,決定聯手死刑犯計連營一起找出真凶及解開背..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of mysterious incidents happen when treasure is discovered in Long Yun Town, including killings of girls. As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 率領神魔眾生征戰天道的上古戰神辰南,經歷沈睡萬年後從雪山之巔的墓群中蘇醒過來,但神力和記憶都被封閉。其後他在與守墓人的激鬥跌入斷崖後,無意間誤入楚國地界。最終辰南在解封自身神力及找回記憶的過程中,更一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ancient God of War Chen Nan, awakens after sleeping in the Snow Mountain for ten thousand years but has lost all his super power and memory. He falls from a cliff in a fight and accidentally enters the Chu State. As Chen Nan gradually restores his strength and memory,  he embarks on a journey to protect the world against evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特警大隊狙擊手張遠和觀察手胡兵在一次行動中,意外將人質李翔打傷致癱瘓。張之後離開特警大隊,與李成為搭檔。三年後,張根據一次調查線索潛入一家制毒工廠,卻發現前隊友胡是工廠負責人。與此同時,張剛巧碰上另一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: SWAT sniper Zhang and his spotter Hu accidentally paralyzed the hostage Li Xiang in an operation. Zhang left the team after and partnered with Li. Three years later, Zhang infiltrates a drug lab in an investigation, only to discover that it is operated by his former teammate Hu. When a drug gang raids the lab, Zhang is trapped in the fierce battle.

Fueled by anger, the Cult leader unites with Shen Gong Pao to exterminate the Zhou army by setting up a thousand deities trap. Meanwhile, Jiang Zi Ya join forces with Yang Jian, Na Zha and other deities to fight the evil forces and rescue mankind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個佛與魔較量的故事。為阻止上古妖魔羅剎降世,將世間顛覆成萬劫不復的寒冰煉獄,少林寺弟子慧海踏上了尋找降龍羅漢之旅。青梅竹馬的上官靈素始終陪伴守護慧海,不畏困難,幫助慧海破除心魔,參透少林精神,最終憑..

Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: As the Ottoman Empire collapses throughout Turkey in 1922, a number of adventurers from all over the world sign on to protect the locals from thieves and marauders--for a hefty price. Two such mercenaries are Adam and Josh, who are hired by provincial Turkish governor Osman. Adam and Josh are expected to protect their boss' gold shipment, and to provide safe conduct for Osman Bey's three daughters. Along the way, our 'heroes' decide to forget their mission and abscond with the gold, but their plans are foiled by their own inherent ineptitude--and by the bothersome interference of duplicitous Colonel Elci.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美,最壯觀的亞洲遺產濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmars most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #2

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明前往粵菜之鄉-香港和廣東,探索傳到世界各地的地區美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廖崇明的最後一站是非常特別的海南島-一個氣候宜人的熱帶島嶼,也是崇明祖先的家鄉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adam Liaws last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adams ancestral home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 森美拉發掘印度美食的起源.她尋找獨家和可靠的地方,說服廚師分享部分秘密,與街頭小販一起煮食,並浪蕩到古老的印度香料市場,帶你一瞥印度豐富的烹飪傳統,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Samira convinces chefs to part with their secrets, cooks with street vendors and wanders into ancient spice markets to give you a peek into India’s rich culinary heritage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哈裡遜福特:好萊塢英雄
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個人都認為自己熟悉夏裡遜福.他們認識富有冒險精神的反納粹考古學家和反烏託邦未來的銀翼殺手.但一旦停下攝錄機,就沒有人真正瞭解演員的真實人生了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyone thinks they know Harrison Ford. They know the adventurous Nazi-fighting archaeologist and the Blade Runner from a dystopian future. But nobody really knows the man behind the movies once the cameras have stopped rolling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穆罕默德阿里是有史以來最偉大的拳擊手,至今仍是全球標誌.他的名字依舊令人尊敬.聽聽那些認識他的人,重溫他的傳奇戰鬥,並探索拳擊界最偉大象徵的一生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Muhammad Ali, the greatest fighter ever, remains a global icon. His name still commands respect. Hear from those who knew him, relive his legendary fights, and explore the life of boxing’s greatest symbol.

epg.programme_title_tc: 茱莉亞羅勃茲:美麗標誌
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索好萊塢最受喜愛的女星 Julia Roberts 的非凡人生.從《麻雀變鳳凰》的突破性演出,到奧斯卡獲獎角色,本片呈現她的成長歷程,持久魅力與對影壇的深遠影響,刻畫一位令人難忘的巨星.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the extraordinary life of Julia Roberts, Hollywood’s beloved icon. From her breakout role in Pretty Woman to her Oscar-winning performances, this documentary explores her journey, enduring charm, and impact on cinema, capturing the heart of

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人.在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習遊泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物--沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友:海豚的協助.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸.雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽.然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibias Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊--海鷗.牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯前往蘇格蘭北部,發現英國石油工業的故事.儘管從第一批石油到今天創新的鑽探機,那是令人難以置信的工程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travelling to the North of Scotland, Rob discovers the story of the British Oil Industry though it’s incredible engineering; from first oil to today’s innovative rigs.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往巴西,一群巨型發電船正處於解決當地逼切的電力需求的最後階段.它們對抗風浪,趕在限期前為200萬戶家庭提供盡可能多的電力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to Brazil where giant powerships are in the final stages of fixing the countrys desperate need for electricity. They battle winds and sea as they race to hit the deadline to send much needed power to two million homes.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信,最複雜的天文臺之一- ALMA.他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to the remote Atacama desert in Chile and to one of the most incredible and complex observatories on Earth - ALMA. He works alongside ALMAs expert team as they repair some of the worlds biggest antennas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 茱莉亞羅勃茲:美麗標誌
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索好萊塢最受喜愛的女星 Julia Roberts 的非凡人生.從《麻雀變鳳凰》的突破性演出,到奧斯卡獲獎角色,本片呈現她的成長歷程,持久魅力與對影壇的深遠影響,刻畫一位令人難忘的巨星.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the extraordinary life of Julia Roberts, Hollywood’s beloved icon. From her breakout role in Pretty Woman to her Oscar-winning performances, this documentary explores her journey, enduring charm, and impact on cinema, capturing the heart of

epg.programme_title_tc: 海倫米蘭:舞臺與銀幕的女王
epg.programme_title_en: Helen Mirren: Queen Of Stage And Screen
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片深入探討 Helen Mirren 無畏的演藝生涯,追溯她從平凡出身到成為全球巨星的旅程,涵蓋她在劇場的早期成就,以及橫跨電影與電視的多元角色表現.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary explores Helen Mirren’s fearless career, tracing her journey from a humble upbringing to becoming a global icon. It covers her early successes in the world of theatre as well as her wide range of film and television roles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片記錄了 Kylie Minogue 非凡的一生與事業,從她在澳洲肥皂劇《鄰居》中的早期演出,到躍升為全球音樂天后的精彩歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary chronicles the extraordinary life and career of Kylie Minogue, from her early days on the Australian soap opera Neighbours to her rise as a global music sensation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑拉德在長達20多年的輝煌職業生涯中體驗並成功晉身球壇巔峰,作為球員和教練捧起過獎盃,又代表過國家隊.但有高山就會伴隨低谷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an illustrious professional career that spans over 20 years, Gerrard has experienced and succeeded at the pinnacle of the sport, lifting trophies as a player and manager, and representing his country. But with the highs, came the lows.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性,感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾巖士唐最完整的人生故事-從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月-以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

epg.programme_title_tc: 傳奇拳王: 曼尼帕奎奧
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是拳擊界最勢不可擋的力量之一的非凡旅程.曼尼柏基奧的傳奇將因其在拳擊場內外所實現的變革而被永遠銘記......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the remarkable journey of one of boxing’s most unstoppable forces. Manny Pacquiao’s legacy will forever be remembered for the change accomplished inside and outside the ring...

epg.programme_title_tc: 米高 J 福克斯:演員樂觀活動家
epg.programme_title_en: Michael J. Fox: Actor, Activist, Optimist
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米高J霍士的一生,從成名到29歲被診斷出患上帕金遜症,就像一部真人秀電影,充滿了意想不到的轉折和顯著的韌性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Michael J. Foxs life, from his rise to fame to a Parkinsons diagnosis at 29, has been nothing short of a real-life movie, marked by unexpected twists and remarkable resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當我們想到好萊塢芸芸眾多藝人時......有一個名字脫穎而出.從他的辛酸到令人難以置信的果報......這就是小勞勃道尼
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When we think of a prolific, yet tumultuous career in Hollywood... A name stands out amongst the crowd. From his hardships to his incredible retribution... This is Robert Downey Jr.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Having just turned 60, Tom Cruise is still one of the leading names in Hollywood. A prolific actor with a career spanning over 40 years, he is continually building a giant legacy within the film industry.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從年輕的葡萄牙神童開始見證有史以來最偉大的球員之一的旅程.這是絕無僅有的...基斯坦勞朗拿度.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the journey from the young Portuguese prodigy to one of the greatest players of all time. This is the one and only...Cristiano Ronaldo.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開.他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程.Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s food journey starts in the West Coast of the South Island. He meets the only NZ cranberry producer at a farm in Hokitika and travels to Blackball to learn how chorizo is made. He cooks a range of dishes at the beach incorporating these local de

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 來到坎特伯裡的高峰牧場,了解這座高地農場從產地到餐桌的體驗,以及家族世代守護土地的故事.接著,他前往多拉荒野海岸,拜訪一對以永續方式採集海鮮的夫婦--他們以推土機將漁船推進大海,展開一天的捕撈旅程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben visits High Peak Station in Canterbury and learns of their high -country farm to fork experience and tales of multigenerational stewardship. On the wild Tora Coast he meets a couple who harvest kaimoana sustainably - launching their fishing boat

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯沿著巴拿馬運河旅行,以瞭解無法被徵服的地峽如何屈服於堅定的工程師的意志和技巧之下,從而創造出現今的七大奇蹟之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rob journeys along the length of the Panama Canal to learn how the un-conquerable Isthmus was bent to the will and skill of determined engineers, creating one of the seven wonders of the Modern World.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從洶湧的海到內陸莫哈維沙漠,獲伯發現一個講述偉大的科羅拉多州如何被馴服和胡佛水壩如何被建造的驚人故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From stormy seas to the land locked Mojave Desert, Rob discovers the amazing story of how the mighty Colorado was tamed and the Hoover Dam built.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯前往蘇格蘭北部,發現英國石油工業的故事.儘管從第一批石油到今天創新的鑽探機,那是令人難以置信的工程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travelling to the North of Scotland, Rob discovers the story of the British Oil Industry though it’s incredible engineering; from first oil to today’s innovative rigs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子,炸雞三文治和越南鯰魚;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的後院,發現美味的素壽司,開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在梅斯卡酒和香料的狂熱中,品嚐了許多當地美食:素海鮮,檸檬汁海鮮冷盤和經典的素食辣醬粟米餅.之後,文拿跟一位當地的奶奶製作傳統的混醬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a frenzy of mezcal and spice, Mena devours a host of local delicacies: plant-based seafood, agua chile and classic enfrijoladas. Later, Mena joins a local abuela to make traditional moles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 德州中心深處是一片素食綠洲;文拿探索另類令人驚喜的德州美味素食:炸雞,巨大無比的餅乾,排骨包和垂涎欲滴的素牛腩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deep in the heart of Texas is a vegan oasis; Mena explores the off-beat Texan Capitols surprising plant-based bounty: fried chicken, larger-than-life biscuits, short rib baos and mouth-watering vegan brisket.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿回鄉與饒舌歌手海特什夏爾馬一起製作素雪糕,然後繞回家品嚐媽媽做的埃及菜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena returns to his home town and makes vegan ice cream with musician Tesher, then swings home to get a taste of his mums Egyptian cooking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利以伊斯坦堡作為旅程的第一站,他在當地見到慢烤羊頭,土耳其鄉村時令食物,如塞滿小茴香肉丸的枇杷,以及用嫩無花果燉的羊肉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the first leg of his journey, Ainsley heads to Istanbul, where he encounters slow-roasted sheeps head, season Turkish village food, like loquats stuffed with cumin-spiced meatballs, and braised lamb with young figs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 芭芭拉史翠珊以其高亢,精緻的嗓音本事和魅力四射的個性,使她成為一生中最具創意和商業上最成功的表演者之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With her highly resonant and sophisticated vocal prowess and charismatic personality, Barbra Streisand rose to fame as one of the most creatively and commercially successful performers of her lifetime.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蒂娜透娜是我們這個時代最偉大的表演者之一,她那具爆發力的嗓音,令人興奮的舞臺表演和啟發性的人生故事俘虜全球數百萬人的心靈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the greatest performers of our time, Tina Turner, has captured the hearts and souls of millions around the world with her powerful voice, electrifying stage presence, and inspiring life story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一部講述歌影戲劇三棲最具魅力人物之一的麗莎明妮莉令人難以置信的生活和職業生涯的傳記式紀錄片.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a frenzy of mezcal and spice, Mena devours a host of local delicacies: plant-based seafood, agua chile and classic enfrijoladas. Later, Mena joins a local abuela to make traditional moles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子,炸雞三文治和越南鯰魚;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, fried `chikn sandwiches and Vietnamese `catfish; Mena forages for lobster mushrooms and visits the oldest tofu factory in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的後院,發現美味的素壽司,開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 德州中心深處是一片素食綠洲;文拿探索另類令人驚喜的德州美味素食:炸雞,巨大無比的餅乾,排骨包和垂涎欲滴的素牛腩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deep in the heart of Texas is a vegan oasis; Mena explores the off-beat Texan Capitols surprising plant-based bounty: fried chicken, larger-than-life biscuits, short rib baos and mouth-watering vegan brisket.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿回鄉與饒舌歌手海特什夏爾馬一起製作素雪糕,然後繞回家品嚐媽媽做的埃及菜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena returns to his home town and makes vegan ice cream with musician Tesher, then swings home to get a taste of his mums Egyptian cooking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利以伊斯坦堡作為旅程的第一站,他在當地見到慢烤羊頭,土耳其鄉村時令食物,如塞滿小茴香肉丸的枇杷,以及用嫩無花果燉的羊肉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the first leg of his journey, Ainsley heads to Istanbul, where he encounters slow-roasted sheeps head, season Turkish village food, like loquats stuffed with cumin-spiced meatballs, and braised lamb with young figs.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 來到黑斯廷斯,發現當地以整合式的全方位方法生產草飼安格斯牛肉.他造訪在地農夫市集,認識了許多優秀的本地食品生產者,展現出這個地區豐饒的農產品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s travels to Hastings and discovers a holistic fully vertically integrated approach to creating grass fed Angus beef. He ventures to the local farmers market and meets amazing local food producers, reinforcing the abundance of produce grown in th

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 拜訪了一位果園經營者與食品創新專家.他們共同的願景是製作天然,以品種為主導的蘋果汁,並採用世界最先進的技術.他也參觀了位於霍克斯灣地中海型氣候下所培育的超過三十種無花果.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,了解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處.他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調.他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用油,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben takes a boat to visit a salmon farm in Akaroa and learns the difference between NZ King and Atlantic salmon. He catches salmon and cooks it on the shoreline overlooking the harbour. He checks out a high-quality homegrown culinary oil that’s both

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長,與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名.他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s stone fruit season! Ben visits a family run orchard in Central Otago known for its long season of stone fruit and a strong connection to the land and community. He discovers an all-electric cherry farm where premium export cherries are sold dire

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯前往蘇格蘭北部,發現英國石油工業的故事.儘管從第一批石油到今天創新的鑽探機,那是令人難以置信的工程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travelling to the North of Scotland, Rob discovers the story of the British Oil Industry though it’s incredible engineering; from first oil to today’s innovative rigs.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往巴西,一群巨型發電船正處於解決當地逼切的電力需求的最後階段.它們對抗風浪,趕在限期前為200萬戶家庭提供盡可能多的電力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to Brazil where giant powerships are in the final stages of fixing the countrys desperate need for electricity. They battle winds and sea as they race to hit the deadline to send much needed power to two million homes.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信,最複雜的天文臺之一- ALMA.他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to the remote Atacama desert in Chile and to one of the most incredible and complex observatories on Earth - ALMA. He works alongside ALMAs expert team as they repair some of the worlds biggest antennas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於漢堡芬肯維德的空中巴士工廠擁有超過 16,000名工人和工程師設計,生產和交付整個歐盟中那些業內領先的飛機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over 16,000 workers and engineers design, produce and deliver industry leading aircraft throughout the European Union at the Airbus factory in Hamburg-Finkenwerder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每十分鐘就有一輛新卡車從生產線出貨,配備了度身訂制的生產線,以滿足瑞典汽車集團-富豪的個別客戶需求.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every ten minutes, a new truck rolls off the assembly line, with a tailor-made production line equipped to cater to individual customer requirements at the Swedish automotive group, Volvo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在下薩克森的邁爾造船廠,世上第一艘天然氣遊輪正在建造當中.這艘337米長的船上可容納多達6,600名乘客,一間電視廣播錄影廠和一座劇院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Meyer Shipyard in Lower Saxony, the worlds first natural gas cruise liner is under construction. There’s room for up to 6,600 passengers, a television broadcast studio and a theater on the 337 meter long ship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊急和特種部隊人員的安全車自有其存在目的.警隊的特種服務車輛是為衝破路障和其他障礙物而設的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The protected transport of emergency and special forces personnel is its raison d』être. The police forces』 special service vehicles are designed for breaking barricades and other obstacles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自2017年以來,風力發電已成為德國第二大能源.全國有近 30,000臺風力渦輪機在運作,覆蓋約19%的能源消耗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Electricity harnessed from wind has become the second largest source of energy in Germany since 2017. Nearly 30,000 wind turbines are operating throughout the country, covering approx. 19 percent of energy consumption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席琳狄翁不用多作介紹.除了成功外,她的私人生活充斥痛苦的悲劇.她的故事關於力量,堅韌和愛.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 拜訪了一位果園經營者與食品創新專家.他們共同的願景是製作天然,以品種為主導的蘋果汁,並採用世界最先進的技術.他也參觀了位於霍克斯灣地中海型氣候下所培育的超過三十種無花果.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,了解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處.他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調.他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用油,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長,與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名.他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往巴西,一群巨型發電船正處於解決當地逼切的電力需求的最後階段.它們對抗風浪,趕在限期前為200萬戶家庭提供盡可能多的電力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to Brazil where giant powerships are in the final stages of fixing the countrys desperate need for electricity. They battle winds and sea as they race to hit the deadline to send much needed power to two million homes.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to the remote Atacama desert in Chile and to one of the most incredible and complex observatories on Earth - ALMA. He works alongside ALMAs expert team as they repair some of the worlds biggest antennas.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to the remote Atacama desert in Chile and to one of the most incredible and complex observatories on Earth - ALMA. He works alongside ALMAs expert team as they repair some of the worlds biggest antennas.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索潘塔納爾濕地400平方英裡的地區,這裡由美洲豹統治,生命都遵循著水的季節節奏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore a 400 square mile region of the Pantanal where jaguars rule and life follows the seasonal rhythm of the water.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《下一站:緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美,最壯觀的亞洲遺產濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmars most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在下薩克森的邁爾造船廠,世上第一艘天然氣遊輪正在建造當中.這艘337米長的船上可容納多達6,600名乘客,一間電視廣播錄影廠和一座劇院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Meyer Shipyard in Lower Saxony, the worlds first natural gas cruise liner is under construction. There’s room for up to 6,600 passengers, a television broadcast studio and a theater on the 337 meter long ship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緊急和特種部隊人員的安全車自有其存在目的.警隊的特種服務車輛是為衝破路障和其他障礙物而設的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The protected transport of emergency and special forces personnel is its raison d』être. The police forces』 special service vehicles are designed for breaking barricades and other obstacles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 自2017年以來,風力發電已成為德國第二大能源.全國有近 30,000臺風力渦輪機在運作,覆蓋約19%的能源消耗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Electricity harnessed from wind has become the second largest source of energy in Germany since 2017. Nearly 30,000 wind turbines are operating throughout the country, covering approx. 19 percent of energy consumption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 德州中心深處是一片素食綠洲;文拿探索另類令人驚喜的德州美味素食:炸雞,巨大無比的餅乾,排骨包和垂涎欲滴的素牛腩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deep in the heart of Texas is a vegan oasis; Mena explores the off-beat Texan Capitols surprising plant-based bounty: fried chicken, larger-than-life biscuits, short rib baos and mouth-watering vegan brisket.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿回鄉與饒舌歌手海特什夏爾馬一起製作素雪糕,然後繞回家品嚐媽媽做的埃及菜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena returns to his home town and makes vegan ice cream with musician Tesher, then swings home to get a taste of his mums Egyptian cooking.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利以伊斯坦堡作為旅程的第一站,他在當地見到慢烤羊頭,土耳其鄉村時令食物,如塞滿小茴香肉丸的枇杷,以及用嫩無花果燉的羊肉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the first leg of his journey, Ainsley heads to Istanbul, where he encounters slow-roasted sheeps head, season Turkish village food, like loquats stuffed with cumin-spiced meatballs, and braised lamb with young figs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本紀錄片記錄了 Kylie Minogue 非凡的一生與事業,從她在澳洲肥皂劇《鄰居》中的早期演出,到躍升為全球音樂天后的精彩歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary chronicles the extraordinary life and career of Kylie Minogue, from her early days on the Australian soap opera Neighbours to her rise as a global music sensation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛登六的湯姆克魯斯仍然是好萊塢頂流之一.作為一位多產的演員,他的職業生涯橫跨40年,不斷在電影界創造巨大的遺產.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Having just turned 60, Tom Cruise is still one of the leading names in Hollywood. A prolific actor with a career spanning over 40 years, he is continually building a giant legacy within the film industry.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 芭芭拉史翠珊以其高亢,精緻的嗓音本事和魅力四射的個性,使她成為一生中最具創意和商業上最成功的表演者之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With her highly resonant and sophisticated vocal prowess and charismatic personality, Barbra Streisand rose to fame as one of the most creatively and commercially successful performers of her lifetime.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From finding a mate in the branches, to adapting to life at height, tree dwelling animals have evolved unique traits to ensure they thrive in this hostile and complex environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Using ingenious adaptations, and devious techniques, prey species have evolved incredible tricks to escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爬行動物,兩棲動物,昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落--而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 僅僅是有一點點不同,就可能帶來巨大的優勢,但同時也會帶來極大的挑戰.這些動物逆勢而行,找到了獨特的生存之道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being just that little bit different, can bring huge advantages, but it also presents almighty challenges. By going against the grain, these animals have found unique ways to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 領略納米比亞千公裡的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景.一同見證超越極限的生命之美!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience Namibia’s wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖,亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. It’s a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信,最複雜的天文臺之一- ALMA.他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球疫情導致世上唯一的水底棲息地停運.米克大衛臣加入裂縫修復小組,一同潛入水中修復它,並讓美國太空總署的太空人返回內部進行訓練.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The worldwide pandemic ceased operations on the worlds only underwater habitat. Mike Davidson joins a crack repair crew as they dive in to bring it back to life and get NASA astronauts back inside for training.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的重型運輸機中隊.他們致力保持CH53超級種馬直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson joins the US Marines Heavy Haulers squadron as theyre put to the test. They battle to keep their fleet of CH53 Super Stallion choppers flying, in preparation for intense warfare training exercises in the desert and mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience Namibia’s wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖,亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. It’s a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 僅僅是有一點點不同,就可能帶來巨大的優勢,但同時也會帶來極大的挑戰.這些動物逆勢而行,找到了獨特的生存之道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being just that little bit different, can bring huge advantages, but it also presents almighty challenges. By going against the grain, these animals have found unique ways to stay alive.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哥斯大黎加 : 大自然的面紗 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯大黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由著名英國演員比爾奈伊聲音導航,這部優質的自然歷史系列揭示令人震驚和稀有的生物所面臨的挑戰,同時造就牠們家園獨特的環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narrated by acclaimed English actor Bill Nighy, this blue-chip natural history series reveals the challenges faced by the astounding and rare creatures that make this unique environment their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由著名英國演員比爾奈伊聲音導航,這部優質的自然歷史系列揭示令人震驚和稀有的生物所面臨的挑戰,同時造就牠們家園獨特的環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narrated by acclaimed English actor Bill Nighy, this blue-chip natural history series reveals the challenges faced by the astounding and rare creatures that make this unique environment their home.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,了解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處.他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調.他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用油,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben takes a boat to visit a salmon farm in Akaroa and learns the difference between NZ King and Atlantic salmon. He catches salmon and cooks it on the shoreline overlooking the harbour. He checks out a high-quality homegrown culinary oil that’s both

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長,與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名.他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s stone fruit season! Ben visits a family run orchard in Central Otago known for its long season of stone fruit and a strong connection to the land and community. He discovers an all-electric cherry farm where premium export cherries are sold dire

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史.他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben experiences the Ruapehu’s region emerging food story and rich history of market gardening. He meets a sixth generation farmer who has turned a remote wilderness into a thriving eco-tourism and fine dining destination, alongside an award winning c

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開.他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程.Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s food journey starts in the West Coast of the South Island. He meets the only NZ cranberry producer at a farm in Hokitika and travels to Blackball to learn how chorizo is made. He cooks a range of dishes at the beach incorporating these local de

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾倫從愛丁堡出發,探索一列奢華列車,與列車主廚會面,造訪二戰與雅各賓紀念地,漫步於莫拉的銀白沙灘,並了解西高地鐵路的工程奇蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alan explores a luxury train from Edinburgh, meets its chef, visits WWII and Jacobite memorials, strolls Morar’s Silver Sands, and learns about the West Highland Line’s engineering marvels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 芭芭拉史翠珊以其高亢,精緻的嗓音本事和魅力四射的個性,使她成為一生中最具創意和商業上最成功的表演者之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With her highly resonant and sophisticated vocal prowess and charismatic personality, Barbra Streisand rose to fame as one of the most creatively and commercially successful performers of her lifetime.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蒂娜透娜是我們這個時代最偉大的表演者之一,她那具爆發力的嗓音,令人興奮的舞臺表演和啟發性的人生故事俘虜全球數百萬人的心靈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the greatest performers of our time, Tina Turner, has captured the hearts and souls of millions around the world with her powerful voice, electrifying stage presence, and inspiring life story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一部講述歌影戲劇三棲最具魅力人物之一的麗莎明妮莉令人難以置信的生活和職業生涯的傳記式紀錄片.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A biographical documentary about the incredible life and career of one of the most charismatic personalities in film, theatre and music: Liza Minnelli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.programme_title_en: Secrets Of The Great White Shark
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著日照越短,天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With days growing shorter and colder, Canadian wildlife is in a race against time, and any animal that fails to make the most of what autumn has to offer will perish.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的重型運輸機中隊.他們致力保持CH53超級種馬直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson joins the US Marines Heavy Haulers squadron as theyre put to the test. They battle to keep their fleet of CH53 Super Stallion choppers flying, in preparation for intense warfare training exercises in the desert and mountains.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣展開一場跨國公路旅行,以幫助井井有條基金會.他們致力尋找並封鎖全美各地估計200萬個洩漏,有毒,可能致命的廢棄石油和天然氣井.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson goes on a cross-country road trip to help the Well Done Foundation. They work to find and cap some of the estimated two million leaking, toxic - potentially deadly abandoned oil and gas wells that are scattered throughout the U.S.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入世上最極端,最容易發生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鳥的團隊.他們使用鏟子,壓雪車,甚至二戰的榴彈砲,奮力保衛陡峭斜坡的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson embeds with the team of one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone mountain ski mountains in the world - Snowbird. They battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer cannon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sports entertainment show brings the best special forces from Iron Squad to take on a new challenge – dodgeball. The 26 players will enter a fierce competition, until a strongest team armed with powerful athletic endurance and mental strength is formed. Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 曾是東北街頭武霸的阿能為了出人頭地,洗心革面來到香港的九龍城寨從零開始打拼,不料卻捲入一場黑惡勢力間的陰謀和混戰。最終為保護被黑惡勢力追殺的好朋友,阿能重拾自我,挺身而出,與城寨居民一同對抗黑惡勢力,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東州地區長期盤踞一支販毒集團。霹靂女子突擊隊隊員梅靜率領其他隊員成功攻入販毒集團的制毒基地,卻中了預先設下的埋伏,梅爸爸是犯罪集團內部的臥底身份亦隨之暴露。最後,梅靜與突擊隊員們經歷一輪激戰後,擊敗對..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退出江湖的特工華叔,在老街以開古董店為生。一天,老街遭當地青龍幫強拆時,華叔隱藏的身份被暴露,並受到阿傑為首的神秘組織追殺,由此展開了一場雙雄對決!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

epg.programme_title_tc: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybrids
epg.programme_title_en: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybri
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Gabriella的家人慘死於混血怪物之手。為了復仇,她投身血獵手的行列,毅然踏上獵殺之途。與同伴並肩,向冷血的地下軍權組織宣戰—一場腥風血雨的亡命激鬥就此展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gabriella is driven by vengeance after a hybrid monster slaughters her family. On her quest, she joins a squad of Blood Hunters and together they wage war against ruthless underworld warlords, igniting a brutal showdown.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金牌保鏢龍威在妻子慘死後患上了創傷後應激障礙,心情低落。他意外結識高科技公司職員Amy,在她邀請下參加了新產品的虛擬測試。龍威測試成功後即成為該公司的虛擬特攻,更獲試用新發明的防護機甲,不料遭遇神秘武..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wifes death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Embark on the journey with two Thai artistes, Gun and Ticha, as they navigate the bustling city life and discover the serene outskirts of Hong Kong.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人稱牠們為「活化石」,但這只是對倖存者的另一個稱呼.從鯊魚到鱟,這些動物的早期適應都十分成功,讓牠們數百萬年來相對地保持不變.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some call them living fossils, but thats just another way to say survivors. From the shark to the horseshoe crab, these animals early adaptations were a success, leaving them relatively unchanged for millions of years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在長期乾旱過後,第一場雨的降臨大大地紓緩了馬達加斯加貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴幫.森林裡的食物十分充足,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹率領族群離開領土大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom. When they return, trespassers are ready for a fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狐?島上的幫派奮力保持族群的健康和領土的完整.隨著嬰兒們成長,牠們的階級架構開始出現裂縫,權力備受考驗.由學習食甚麼,交友,結盟到在族群中找到一席之地,狐?島上嬰兒的生活跟成年狐?一樣艱辛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the babies grow, new power struggles break out in each troop. Watch as every member, from fierce Queen Crystal to low-ranking Erica, jockeys for position. Meanwhile, the babies start to understand how allies and enemies will shape their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格,帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言,複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞洛斯亞諾斯的扁平稀樹草原受到季節性極端的影響,將生命推向絕境.在這個無情的舞台上,沒有第二次機會,只有最適應殘酷極端的生物才能度過一年.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雌性絨頂檉柳猴蒙娜在她的熱帶森林家園獨居.她離開了原生家庭的安全區,尋找一個可能為她提供未來伴侶的未知隊伍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mona, a female cotton top tamarin is all alone in her tropical forest home. She has left the security of her birth family to search for an unrelated troop which might provide her with a future mate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的春天從9月初開始,大自然變得生氣盎 然.日照變長,氣溫上升,動植物緊密合作繁殖,生育和養育幼兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的潮間帶是獨特動植物的家園.那裡的生命已經適應在充滿挑戰的海洋環境中生存,一些物種能夠活在裸露的岩石上,而其他則寧願留在岩池的庇護下.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The African intertidal zone is home to a unique universe of plants and creatures. Here, life has adapted to survive in a challenging marine environment - some species are able to live on exposed rocks, while others prefer the shelter of rock pools.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,只有六分一的幼崽能倖存.被父母拋棄的她唯有靠自己.馴鹿群在未結冰的水裡游了兩英里.每年的繁殖季節有35,000隻灰海豹來到蘇格蘭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞洛斯亞諾斯的扁平稀樹草原受到季節性極端的影響,將生命推向絕境.在這個無情的舞台上,沒有第二次機會,只有最適應殘酷極端的生物才能度過一年.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雌性絨頂檉柳猴蒙娜在她的熱帶森林家園獨居.她離開了原生家庭的安全區,尋找一個可能為她提供未來伴侶的未知隊伍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mona, a female cotton top tamarin is all alone in her tropical forest home. She has left the security of her birth family to search for an unrelated troop which might provide her with a future mate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的春天從9月初開始,大自然變得生氣盎 然.日照變長,氣溫上升,動植物緊密合作繁殖,生育和養育幼兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring: the season of courtship and new life. Witness nature awaken from its slumber in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的潮間帶是獨特動植物的家園.那裡的生命已經適應在充滿挑戰的海洋環境中生存,一些物種能夠活在裸露的岩石上,而其他則寧願留在岩池的庇護下.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The African intertidal zone is home to a unique universe of plants and creatures. Here, life has adapted to survive in a challenging marine environment - some species are able to live on exposed rocks, while others prefer the shelter of rock pools.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在長期乾旱過後,第一場雨的降臨大大地紓緩了馬達加斯加貝倫地保育區的環尾狐猴幫.森林裡的食物十分充足,對立幫派領導人姬絲圖和嘉緹率領族群離開領土大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The drought is finally over, but traversing the forest for food is still a gamble. See some leaders take the risk, leaving home territories undefended to feast on a cicada boom. When they return, trespassers are ready for a fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探小熊們在夏季如何學習爬樹和覓食,為重返野外生活做好準備.迎接一批新成員驚喜入營,見證熊寶貝們進入冬眠前的大吃特吃,並享受一場盛大的小熊感恩祭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spy on the summer cubs as they learn to climb trees and forage for food in preparation for their release into the wild. Get surprised by a set of new arrivals, observe the annual pre-hibernation eating binge, and enjoy a bear-friendly Thanksgiving.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格,帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言,複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The first sense to evolve in the first animals was chemoreception: being able to detect chemicals in the animals environment. This helps animals find prey and mates, and to sense predators from a distance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」.本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年頭幾個月裡,地軸的傾斜為某些地方帶來夏天,某些地方則是冬天.瞭解生物如何在這些極端條件下生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the early months of the year, the Earths axial tilt brings the height of summer in some places and the depths of winter in others. See how life struggles to survive under these extreme conditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從遍及日本的櫻花浪潮到最終到達大堡礁產卵的綠海龜群,環遊世界去見證三月發生的大氣變化,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the globe to witness the atmospheric shifts that take place in March, from the wave of cherry blossoms that unfold across Japan to the final raft of green sea turtles that arrive on the Great Barrier Reef islands to lay eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer brings long, warm days for wildlife to thrive. Watch animals learn new skills, compete for mates, and escape predators as they try to make the most of the short season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲的東海岸,溫暖的厄加勒斯角以獨特的亞熱帶景觀向南延伸.從紅樹林沼澤到色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁所構成的區域,當中有在長而暖的沙灘上繁殖的海龜,以及最近才發現的「活化石」- 腔棘魚,牠棲息在深海底的峽谷中.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從遍及日本的櫻花浪潮到最終到達大堡礁產卵的綠海龜群,環遊世界去見證三月發生的大氣變化,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the globe to witness the atmospheric shifts that take place in March, from the wave of cherry blossoms that unfold across Japan to the final raft of green sea turtles that arrive on the Great Barrier Reef islands to lay eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 觸覺能讓物種感知各種物理力量所帶的感覺,包括得知咬傷,感受溫度變化和不同質地.一些動物對非常微弱的振動特別敏感,牠們能從中獲得大量關於環境的訊息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sense of touch is useful to feel physical forces such as bites, changes in temperature and texture. Some animals have become extra sensitive to very faint vibrations, which gives them a lot of information about their environment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年頭幾個月裡,地軸的傾斜為某些地方帶來夏天,某些地方則是冬天.瞭解生物如何在這些極端條件下生存.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚,虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅.讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 保護區的猩猩六年級了,他們將面臨放歸野外的考驗,和他們一起體驗這個歷程中的情緒過山車和成長痛苦.探索迪拉的命運是如何突然改變的,並觀看大男孩貝尼如何應對令人討厭的節食計劃.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience a roller coaster of emotions and growing pains as the sanctuarys orangutans move through six grades toward their release into the wild. Discover how Dillas fate suddenly changes, and watch as big boy Beni goes on an unwelcome diet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨人類學家吉爾普魯茨及嚮導東多康德,即場見證演化在眼前發生.走進塞內加爾豐戈利,認識一群行蹤隱秘的黑猩猩,牠們懂得使用工具,與火互動,並在與人類世界不斷交會之際,展現出驚人的適應能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join anthropologist Jill Pruetz and guide Dondo (Johnny) Kanté and watch evolution happen in real time. Meet the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, who use tools, interact with fire, and adapt to the human world as it collides with their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來機會.非洲毛皮海獅,白喉猴,變色龍和黑斑羚等對秋季有所反應.秋天引發了許多動物的生活變化.稀有生物露面,獵食者聚集起來製造優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As fall sweeps across America and trees are set ablaze with color, animals are faced with make-or-break decisions. Find out how bald eagles, beavers, and other creatures prepare for the colder, darker, and leaner months ahead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲的東海岸,溫暖的厄加勒斯角以獨特的亞熱帶景觀向南延伸.從紅樹林沼澤到色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁所構成的區域,當中有在長而暖的沙灘上繁殖的海龜,以及最近才發現的「活化石」- 腔棘魚,牠棲息在深海底的峽谷中.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #2
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 保護區的猩猩六年級了,他們將面臨放歸野外的考驗,和他們一起體驗這個歷程中的情緒過山車和成長痛苦.探索迪拉的命運是如何突然改變的,並觀看大男孩貝尼如何應對令人討厭的節食計劃.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeing the world is one of the most amazing animal adaptations. Different types of eyes give animals different types of vision, and in some cases they can be extraordinary.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿,怪誕的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一窺大自然中最兇猛的鬥士,牠們以暴力來爭奪所需.觀看肉食的波爾夏蜘蛛如何吞噬對手,揭開可愛無尾熊的嗜血一面,並捲入長頸鹿之間一場激烈的頸項對決.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the ring with natures top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入暸解地球上最強悍的動物幫派,見證野外求生的真正力量.追蹤一群獵食中的蝗蟲,觀察邊蛸如何埋伏獵物,並拜會一群已培養出嗜血習性的雀鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches whove developed a taste for blood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的冬天帶來乾旱,冰雪和風暴.在此生活的動物必須與天氣,土地和彼此競爭.獵豹,海豹,禿鷹和狐獴.雨水終於結束旱季,並引發了生命的爆發性發展.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位處非洲南部海岸的阿爾哥亞灣,是該大陸唯一的企鵝避難所.跟企鵝一起求生,牠們勇於接受難以容忍的因素,以建立一個不可能的海洋社區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The population of African penguins in Southern Africa is on the decline, but the charismatic species has found a stronghold on two islands in Algoa Bay. This is the story of the penguins daily struggle to raise families in an unforgiving and host...
